The 14th Amendment is the cornerstone of our democracy. The Amendment establishes that everyone is entitled to equal protection under the law, and that the state cannot deprive any person in its jurisdiction of life, liberty, or property without a fair trial. Unfortunately, **I know too well that the government doesn’t always respect our constitutional rights.** I was born in a Japanese Internment camp in Poston, Arizona. Over 120,000 other Japanese-Americans were imprisoned based solely on race and nationality. You also know this, as just this year we saw Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) murder Americans in the street, rip children away from their families, and wrongly deport people like Kilmar Armando Ábrego García with no trials to be imprisoned in nations they have no connection to. The 14th Amendment also established birthright citizenship, the idea that anyone born in the United States, regardless of their parents’ legal status, is a citizen. For years, the Trump administration has attacked birthright citizenship, and it wasn’t until two weeks ago that the Supreme Court decided, 6-3, that the 14th Amendment clearly enumerates this right. **[I will never stop fighting to ensure the Trump administration respects the constitutional rights it must uphold, but I need your help to keep doing so. Friends,
I was on _CNN_ with Kasie Hunt this afternoon, and if you missed it, I wanted to tell you myself what we talked about - because it matters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e131cfb4-f7ae-47d1-92b0-c0fbc11b5ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Here 's the heart of it: This primary is now a two-person race.**
The choice in front of Michigan Democrats is Abdul El-Sayed or me. Two options. That's it, the whole kit and caboodle. And with the primary less than a month away and absentee ballots already in voters' hands, this race is no longer some far-off thing on the calendar. It's happening right now.
So the question Kasie asked - and the question every Michigan voter deserves a straight answer to - is simple: How do we win this election?
_The Cook Political Report_ has already weighed in. They said, "If El-Sayed wins the primary, Democrats have little chance of holding the seat."
And look, that's not some Stevens campaign talking point. That's the opinion of nonpartisan folks whose whole job is being real about Senate races.
Senate Republicans have clearly done the same math. Why else would their campaign arm be spending money in a Democratic primary to prop up Abdul El-Sayed? The truth is they'd rather face him in November than face me.
I said it on _CNN_ , and I will say it again here: **Michigan will decide control of the U.S. Senate, and it 's very hard to see a path to flipping the Senate without winning here.** So what happens in the next few weeks will help determine whether Donald Trump has a rubber stamp from Mike Rogers or a real check on his agenda.
None of this is abstract, friends. This is real-life stuff with real consequences for Michiganders.
I'm talking about Social Security, reproductive freedom, gas prices, and manufacturing. I'm talking about health care - and whether working families have someone in the Senate fighting for them.
Poll after poll shows I'm the Democrat best positioned to beat Mike Rogers. Not because I'm the flashiest person in the room. Not because I've gone viral. But Because I've spent my career with my sleeves rolled up, doing the work.
I helped save 200,000 Michigan auto jobs during President Obama's auto rescue. I helped bring semiconductor manufacturing back home. I've won tough races in Michigan before, and I know what it takes to build the kind of coalition that wins in Michigan in November.
**Michiganders know the difference between a candidate who talks about the fight and one who 's been in the arena.** I've been doing the work for this state I love - and now it's time to earn every last vote.
So that's the next 26 days: a two-person race. Ballots out. Senate control on the line. National Republicans already meddling in our primary. And a campaign that's going to outwork everybody, every single day, until August 4.
If you saw the interview and you're in a position to chip in, I'd be truly grateful. This is a people-centered grassroots campaign, and your $20, or whatever you can manage, helps us reach voters in these final weeks while it matters most.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/e131cfb4-f7ae-47d1-92b0-c0fbc11b5ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you.
With grit and determination,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/e131cfb4-f7ae-47d1-92b0-c0fbc11b5ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

body:
I take this job pretty seriously, Peter.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260709-1&t=1&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)
Peter,
I take this job pretty seriously.
I spend a lot of time thinking about how to help every single one of the candidates we endorse win their elections. And you want to know one thing that helps me sleep at night?
It’s knowing that, since our launch in 2023, **almost 16,000 of our grassroots supporters** have signed up to make monthly recurring donations to Leaders We Deserve.
**[These donations are crucial to sustaining a movement like ours, so today I wanted to reach out and ask if you would set up a monthly recurring donation too.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5229?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.qYJIwU&refcode=em20260709-3701&amount=5&t=2&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**
_Use the links in this email to start a recurring donation to Leaders We Deserve._
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5229?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.qYJIwU&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-3701&t=3&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**
Here’s why these recurring donations are so helpful:
* They allow us to set a baseline for what we bring in each month, so we can budget that money toward our most pressing priorities.
* They help us get to work well before Election Day. A month before the election is too late to hire and train organizers, buy TV ads, and compete with more established, well-financed campaigns.
* They help create a snowball effect for our candidates. A lot of donors and organizations look at how much early money candidates raise to inform whether they should get involved, and recurring donations let us back young, progressive candidates early on to show their credibility.

**[So if you’re ready to elect more of the leaders we deserve, please sign up to make a monthly recurring donation of any amount that works for you today. It will help more than you know!](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5229?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.qYJIwU&refcode=em20260709-3701&amount=5&t=4&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**
Thanks again for all your support,
David Hogg
P.S. Can’t commit to a monthly donation today? Not a problem. **[If you can make a one-time contribution of $5 or any amount at all, you’ll make a big difference in helping us reach our goals and elect the next generation of leaders.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.ZGVbos&refcode=em20260709-3701&amount=5&t=5&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**

body:
We must stop the suppressive SAVE Act and all of its clones in the Senate, because the opponents of voting rights in the House keep trying to check these voter suppression bills off their to-do list.
Why? Listen to Senator Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut:
(Image of Richard Blumenthal speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_RB.jpg]
RUSH $35 or more right now to stop these bills, defend our right to vote, and stop opponents of voting rights from destroying our democracy >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070926_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Donald Trump is demanding -- again -- that Congress pass the SAVE America Act (the latest version of the anti-voting SAVE Act). With the House set to pass it again this week, the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections, folks.
Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. Here's Colorado Senator Michael Bennet on the impact of these bills:
(Image of Michael Bennet speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_MB.jpg]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this bill because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, join these brave Senators today. Fuel our efforts to stop this dangerous legislation with $35 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070926_2&amount=35]

GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070926_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070926_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070926_2&amount=50]

We know the SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before November, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE America Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070926_2&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=070926_2&amount=20]

Hi there, it’s Nancy Lacore, the Democrat running to flip South Carolina’s First District.
I have a lot of thoughts about what’s been going on with Pete Hegseth.
Not only did he remove me from my position as Chief of the Navy Reserve after 35 years of service, but he’s actively undermining the foundation of our military.
Hegseth has fired more than a dozen senior military officers, including an Army chief of staff and two other generals who were ousted recently.
And now, he’s waging a war with Iran that could put our national security and countless American lives on the line.
That kind of behavior isn’t just destabilizing – it’s dangerous.
Now more than ever, we need leadership that’s rooted in honor, service, and respect. And that’s exactly why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s First District.
If we’re going to flip this seat and take back a Democratic House Majority, I need your help. Can you make a split donation of $25 or whatever you can, to Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
DONATE NOW TO HELP NANCY FLIP THIS SEAT! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
I’ll be honest, folks, I’m concerned.
While global tensions rise, the last thing we need is reckless leadership that’s willing to gamble with American lives.
We need steady, experienced leaders who are focused on delivering results – not inciting chaos, playing political games, and putting their own interests above the nation’s.
And I’m running for Congress to restore that kind of leadership – but we have a long road ahead of us to flip this seat and restore some accountability to Washington.
This is one of the most competitive races in the country, and it could decide control of the House. So I need all hands on deck to win. So I have to humbly ask: Will you split $25 today to support Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]

Iran War Reignites
President Trump declared the U.S.-Iran ceasefire "over" Wednesday and [ordered fresh strikes](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1yhSAUhJ9GOxw8KngLijR2N21K5wTw3pPw4wBKkqfPmEdItbvF7s58b_f1juQoPF7RW6VPWk006-6wBJviUYz1UScs2Vh0lVbgIBiXjN_W4Na-NUobMUBrVS_nQYwgblP7VEK_CxgnDRvIDbicJ2EMiF72YponxJbUtcRlzznv537o-LjhZgYr5STNJHUz8mM3WGzudAzZphMLnZZCiJeLodPRt049S9lzM7w0sDSw1Fq7LX4FW6-ab2BxdFp25QaWkg6_syMzShhYxcRySfRp86VIhT1j8scP-zjcN7u1SZm9knOUhWxG_vBI7u-1_APUqeA3AAD__wRMef0) on roughly 90 Iranian military targets after Tehran resumed attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. The Islamabad memorandum collapsed as Iran targeted tankers in the vital waterway. [Oil markets jumped](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LHO3CAQBOCnwR0WYAx3BUUad3_alNb-7PpuFQwWcHYeP3IeId0Un0aj-fW1fgEnzq-fsFOIJ69YcD0S9Ey1fDrSXmKF3pAgXbwaZZxUXqrnmtOqBwwR3WQGCto_JmeNe87DO9gnPaJDQ_Om3TfSFr0CPVv9rSerjB443E3Ka6WUfuhpVHaDDSfyfvY4-yis-hwIndoYS25UT-h8Eudc7lTyGMs-pPDu_Whi-iHMIsxyXdd4QXtzfvWS6Q_snKneVJgl09VuU2pCYRbrrFJ-FmYpnORROVKT7eDfJHv97IdEigkqoYwEjTauJLlCluWkKswy1IDHxSlxc15Y9dqB079V_T-OPIP5GwAA___o3oR5), with Brent climbing above $78 and pump prices ticking up nationwide. Trump said Iran called seeking a new deal but questioned whether Tehran could be trusted. The administration also [revoked sanctions waivers](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLuypSAURL8GMyzEBxoQTEJ2J53Q2he2nj3DwwKU35865xNu1kl3r1p_vvYvIE_x_A0BtX1od8ntl4caMae7OgzJZqjFIfhGuxRy4UJxse3R70PntHXLKDvUg1rHZZLLNncvvQmLbhICcB6-1aoGPI5RidU5uW64fnek30tCDUKIYR3GXkwHHG5EpWblZmXZJO7LQcXS2xQL5gcqPUgxpndKsbcpdF6_ar0KG38xaZg0rbW-QXlRPGuKlcKnHpg0EVth0rxfmTR_b8-kWZk0d-GUIXKLUPCgjNwm7-EqWDgEcjxi46Vm-oeF13yHi4fb-8Izlgq5UjyZNF3W7mrkPZVFsUmcAch_COsPpD5a_g8AAP__iHOJbQ) that had let Iran sell crude during the truce. Republicans framed the response as restoring deterrence, with Trump warning any further attack would be met "twenty-fold." ★★★
Judge Spared In ICE Case
Former Milwaukee County Judge Hannah Dugan was [fined $5,000](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0DvOpDAQBODTQGZkzMMzgYNNyGbTDVFjN9AjP5DdwB5_xR7hzyqpT6X685k_QJ7i9hsCGnvR7JKbDw8cMaeTHYZkM3BxCP6mWUk1CqmFfM_Rz23tjHVjp2o0rX51Y6_G91Dv5mWXzsmllasc7Khbi0raDvoVYLE4YE3mkaRupZTtq-0a2a-wug61HrQbtK16eR4OGEtjUyyYL2C6kGJMT0qxsSnU3uzMR6m6X5WaKjXd992s6W_E-6mFSk1H8sRkS6WmNeWAWdxUHpGi-J5uQ7FDjLALd24QBVyJXBFfIC-YAoq0FM6nZYqbgJyxsCDvcQMvKATaMkSus3HHTd5TGXXVyy0A-f_7-AeXXkb9CwAA__-zr4wO) and spared prison on Wednesday for obstructing a federal immigration arrest inside her courthouse, despite facing up to 5 years in prison. U.S. District Judge Lynn Adelman, a Clinton appointee, [cited her service](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGyozAQRE8jMrnEYCQcEGxC9jfdkBprBhiXkFySgOtv2Uf4WSf9uuv9-5l_UILE9S_uPPpTZko0vwPWyDkdlXhPPmMtxBgumcGA1cZp85hjmNuGRk-2g4bH1g2dvYN99M02ekBnoKfetsMTwD2Y3NM8npbZ4rDYRsYPybjWGNMObXcz9wUX6ti53lHvvLqb401Yudx8ioXziVVOlhjTJ6V482lvwrjV-i6q-6NgUjBd13W7sGwS15pilf1b3xVMka-iYPqsKpheR1AwDQqmDWPETdOxYtRLyjtn_TpoZX1tSadnqfnwlUmLZ405c6l6kcik8UxCRb9QPqwmj_S-JAQp1qm7WXeU8P1Yf6H1HOF_AAAA__8sFIlq) and called her a good person who made a bad decision. Dugan had ushered an illegal immigrant out a side door as ICE agents waited in April 2025. Prosecutors argued she violated her oath and endangered officers and the public. Conservatives blasted the [lenient sentence](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL3SpCAURJ8GMyy8_qABwSZk36YbWixcnTuFYAHKPP6W8wibddJ9us6fn_XHkKew_zYHKnvT6qJbT29KwBSv4vCINpmSHRpfaQUBExeSi2UNfu0ap6ybemhQdXLupwGmZWxeCsQ2oh0tdK7HTWyzW8QwIYrZ9uMilobUsyRkJ4To5q5vxbCZzfUo5SjdKC0bxHU6UzC3NoaM6TaFbqQQ4pNiaG08Gq9epZyZ9b8YaAa61tpWk18U9hJDoeNbPxjogDUz0A-VgX5fnoGeGWj88Er5QVDg78vtyPNpEjp-Jsox8Pg3l3TZQmHnZJGblDAXfuCHrAkMdJOUOyt5T3mSbBD7Ych_35X_EHor-BcAAP__MdSHuA) as a two-tier standard, noting guidelines called for 15 to 21 months behind bars. Dugan plans to appeal. ★★★
Vance Task Force Targets Fraud
Vice President JD Vance's anti-fraud task force uncovered a staggering 7,100% surge in Medicare claims for skin substitutes, [officials revealed](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL0OnDAQhJ8GOiNjDIbCRRq6S5sSbXbN3er8g2wDefyIPEK6mWJGn75fr-0F7Dm-f0JwFi_eKNF2eKjR5XRWciFhhlrIgb95U1JNQhohly36rW_JIk2Dap3tzTxMWk3L2H6sHpbJDAshLXoZZ5Kjnns5okKcjZ6xZfs8SdNLKfu5Hzqpd9hpcMaMhkaDjZbnQVBd6TDF4vIFlS_HMaYnpdhhCq23n1qP0gw_GrU2ar3vu9vTn-juZxYatR7Jc2UsjVprPsMhgAJHcUZMl8tFPASinPntRHDECNmJmiGWw0OsAj1wKAJiZbFnOElgBvxSuqP47RN-HYnA3nOKpc2WjvspZTKNlu8A7P9h1v8we1n1NwAA__9cjIxl) -- from $200 million in 2019 to $14.4 billion in 2025. CMS Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz said the agency has flagged 4,200 suspicious claims and denied 96% of them since March. Speaking in Milwaukee, [Vance touted](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0DGSrCAUheHVYNbW5YKgAcFLzPqlE1oIl26qECylZZY_5SxhspOcL_i_nsvTxhTz67_dyLgrLr74ZU-2ZjrKp3raijtsPT3Z1OKCgOoB-gHTktPCO2-cVwI7MlyPQklU09C9DScHKFxY5aiRa6kGjhymKawSh3UNXTS3BJoDAB-56EEGG7wgrQftB-2YhM_ubaWzdyWfdFy2xotizuVeJfeubF0y71r3k4l_DGeGc2utD-U7U7tvG8P5ip4Kw1lJgEGJCUfOsTuM31tMKZ5KMwmvzcb0C9Y_NLgM_gQAAP__PzZpgg) a broad crackdown spanning Medicaid, visas, and elections. In the primary, our opponent had over $8.5 million in combined spending between his multiple adversary Super PACs and spending over $5.3 million of his own money. So we know that this will still be an expensive and competitive general election, as our opponent will continue to self-fund and has the support of wealthy out-of-district Silicon Valley donors and multiple Super PACs. subject: Wisconsin's own regulators just admitted it

body:
The report Big Tech doesn't want you to read
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260709-3013)
Peter,
Last week, Wisconsin utility regulators released a [report](https://act.francescahong.com/go/15905?t=1&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) that outlines the impact of AI data centers.
Our state's peak electricity demand is projected to surge [40%](https://act.francescahong.com/go/15906?t=2&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) in just six years. And nearly three-quarters of that entire spike (72%) comes from just three hyperscale data centers: Beaver Dam, Port Washington, and Mount Pleasant.
_The hero Wisconsin deserves!_
The issue is not your air conditioner, nor is it Wisconsin farms or small businesses. We’re getting hosed by three data centers owned by some of the richest corporations in human history.
How do the utilities plan to meet this demand? The single biggest chunk of new power (5.4 gigawatts of it) will come from fossil gas plants. That means [coal retirements will be delayed](https://act.francescahong.com/go/15907?t=3&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) and dirty energy will be locked in for decades. All so Big Tech can train chatbots.
There is still no statewide plan for any of this. No guardrails. No guarantee you won't end up paying for it on your utility bill.
This is exactly why Fran has been calling for a [moratorium on new hyperscale data centers.](http://act.francescahong.com/go/15908?t=4&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) Her plan is a common-sense pause until Wisconsin has real rules that protect our grid, our water, our climate, and our wallets. When Fran first said it, the political class called it radical. Now the state's own energy assessment is proving her right.
The other candidates in this race won't say the word "moratorium." Fran will. She works for you, not the corporations rewriting Wisconsin's energy future behind closed doors.
[**The primary is August 11. That’s just under 5 weeks away. Chip in $10 to elect the only candidate who saw this coming and has a plan to stop it.**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260709.z7esw6&refcode=em20260709-3013&t=5&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260709.z7esw6&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-3013&t=8&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)**
In solidarity,
— Team Hong
P.S. [70% of Wisconsin voters (](https://act.francescahong.com/go/16017?t=9&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)[_across party lines_](https://act.francescahong.com/go/16017?t=10&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)[)](https://act.francescahong.com/go/16017?t=11&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) already believe data centers cost us more than they give back. Fran is the only candidate standing with that 70%. [Stand with her today](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260709.z7esw6&refcode=em20260709-3013&t=12&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7).
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260709-3013&t=13&refcode2=3013_105371_b9Ufs7&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)**

“Not qualified.” That’s
what the American Bar Association rated one of Trump’s judicial nominees
because they lack the basic qualifications for the bench.

Let us explain: Trump has nominated 60 crony judges to the federal
judiciary in his second term — 45 of whom have been confirmed.

They’ve been asked the simplest questions about reality. Who won the 2020
election? Was January 6th an attack on the Capitol?

And they all refuse to give a straight answer, because apparently the sole
qualification needed for a lifetime seat on the bench is loyalty to Trump
only.

This is Trump’s playbook: hand-pick judges who'll never rule against him,
push them through confirmation, and fill the bench with political puppets
who will protect him at all costs.

We’re calling it what it is — stacking the courts. And Demand Justice PAC
isn’t going to sit back and watch it happen.

We're digging into these nominees' records, putting their loyalty tests on
the record, and turning up the pressure so senators feel it every time

Hard work and playing by the rules used to be enough. That was the deal. You show up, put in the hours, do everything right, and you build something stable. A home. A future. A life your kids can step into with confidence.
**That deal is broken, and politicians like my opponent Scott DesJarlais helped break it.**
While families across Tennessee's 4th District are working two jobs just to cover groceries, while parents lie awake wondering if their kids will ever be able to afford a home of their own, DesJarlais has spent 14 years in Washington protecting the donors and insiders who bankroll his career. **How do I know?**_**I 'm living it **_**with my boys:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8f3537f6-5d2d-4d43-a475-a841ac548e25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**I 'm running for Congress because I look at my boys and I refuse to accept that the America they inherit is one where effort doesn't matter anymore. [Will you stand with us?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b6ade95c-cc78-45ce-92dc-32ee7adbae9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Chip in $25, Help us hit our goal!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b6ade95c-cc78-45ce-92dc-32ee7adbae9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We aren't seeing representation anymore. Corporate and Foreign interests have infiltrated our government. The "American Dream" isn't their priority anymore because **corporate checks line their pockets.**
To Scott DesJarlais and every other bought-and-paid-for politician in Washington: consider this your notice. I got to this state with nothing to my name, and was able to build a family while pulling through the worst. My goal is to make sure **you** can do the same, and not have to break your back in the process.
The people of this district are done waiting, and we're coming. ☑️ _**[Chip in $20 today and let's finish this.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b6ade95c-cc78-45ce-92dc-32ee7adbae9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)☑️**_

body:
When we talk about creating opportunity, we must ensure that no community in Wisconsin is left behind, whether it's a rural town in the Northwoods or an urban neighborhood in Milwaukee.
Peter,When we talk about creating opportunity, we must ensure that no community in Wisconsin is left behind, whether it's a rural town in the Northwoods or an urban neighborhood in Milwaukee.**That's why I was incredibly proud to lead the effort to select and finalize Wisconsin's 120 federally designated Economic Opportunity Zones under the Trump administration.****[[BUILD OPPORTUNITY IN WISCONSIN ➔]](https://willmartinforltgovernor.cmail19.com/t/j-l-ydujudhk-hkjudtlhit-r/)**These zones were designed to incentivize private investment in economically distressed areas. Instead of relying on big-government handouts, we used conservative tax incentives to encourage job creators to invest right here in our communities.This initiative helped:
* Attract millions of dollars in private capital to Wisconsin.
* Create jobs in communities that had been forgotten for decades.
* Build a solid foundation for long-term economic prosperity.

**This is the power of conservative economic policy. When we cut taxes and encourage investment, Wisconsin wins.** As your Lieutenant Governor, I will continue to champion these free-market principles to revitalize our state.Our grassroots campaign is powered by supporters who believe in the power of opportunity. Can you chip in $10, $20, or $50 today to help us share this vision with voters across the state?**[[BUILD OPPORTUNITY IN WISCONSIN ➔]](https://willmartinforltgovernor.cmail19.com/t/j-l-ydujudhk-hkjudtlhit-y/)**Thank you for your support!Best regards,Will Martin

name: Sara Lambdin
subject: Get Out the Vote for Kevin Fagan!
body:
Hi Peter,

My name is Sara, and I recently stepped into the Volunteer Coordinator role
for Kevin Fagan’s campaign. We’re in the final stretch before the primary,
and door knocking or phone banking to connect with our community about
Kevin Fagan is the most important thing we can be doing right now.

We really need folks out in the field over the next few weeks, and I’d love
to hear how you’ve been involved so far and how you’re hoping to plug in
from here. If you’re able to take on a shift (or a few!), it would make a
huge impact.

I’m also happy to connect 1:1 on the phone if you’d like to talk through
volunteer opportunities, share feedback, or ask any questions.

Here are a few quick ways to get involved:

-

Slack (our main communication hub):
https://join.slack.com/t/kevinforcongressgroup/shared_invite/zt-41awqi9a8-YUXby_uhQWTV5PXhAHrHng
-

Volunteer sign-ups for the rest of the month:
https://forms.gle/aRFnm6FwKJMnD2R77
-

Yard sign requests: https://forms.gle/DmDsJ25nVbGRSUiq5

Thank you so much for being part of this—every conversation counts right
now, and we’re so excited to have you out there with us supporting Kevin
Fagan.

Best,
Sara Lambdin

509-481-7471

Kevin Fagan for Congress

name: Doug Lloyd for MI Attorney General
subject: We Will Make Michigan More Affordable
body:
Go after bad corporate actors, prosecute organized retail theft, and end black markets
| | |
---
| | [](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h5RDsn5rT6olmVWrpQAuEs1mGPkqqdlLO4oMGxuGseIPfyO8ixYTDYWvOFrBd8hznXDz-MnobmnZpMFUrw4ahez-h4sDYc6q36trMXl990x3Y4pYj8jJwZoFCdgsFonMZF2UCll_tSTykfXNajNQUT1LVet2tw3LMH3WNKtW0oo=&c=uAoMyEUJnO5JKu7FWV8b51sN5R-7aC8uzn_-7Exe2UEeGHNyv-dfGg==&ch=SBI1QDA6qTq3u4xVZjbUd8ypfjMEKe09lnZ9ke8uqmtePjw67hLPMQ==)
---
| | | [](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h5RDsn5rT6olmVWrpQAuEs1mGPkqqdlLO4oMGxuGseIPfyO8ixYTDYWvOFrBd8hznXDz-MnobmnZpMFUrw4ahez-h4sDYc6q36trMXl990x3Y4pYj8jJwZoFCdgsFonMZF2UCll_tSTykfXNajNQUfMe2PuV6mGdhU_C2G9okkU=&c=uAoMyEUJnO5JKu7FWV8b51sN5R-7aC8uzn_-7Exe2UEeGHNyv-dfGg==&ch=SBI1QDA6qTq3u4xVZjbUd8ypfjMEKe09lnZ9ke8uqmtePjw67hLPMQ==)
---
| | Friends,
Life is unaffordable for too many Michiganders. Costs of groceries and gas have skyrocketed. People are struggling to afford housing and the energy needed to heat or cool their homes.
While the Attorney General's office can't control the legislation coming out of Lansing that affects cost of living, there is a vital part of the office that can impact what we pay and fight higher prices.
I have made it clear from the beginning of my campaign that I will root out government corruption, waste, and fraud to protect taxpayers and keep Lansing from coming for more of your hard-earned money.
But there is more that an AG can do. Far too many Michiganders are being abused by fraudulent business practices and we need an AG who will put a stop to it.
When I'm Attorney General, our office will work day and night to fight higher prices and protect consumers by going after bad corporate actors that rip off Michigan families and seniors with scams, price gouging, and deceptive practices.
This isn't anything new for me. As Eaton County Prosecutor, I oversee the county's Economic Crime Unit. Under my leadership, the office has become one of our state's premier white collar crime units as we prosecute welfare fraud, help businesses recover stolen money and property, and hold contractors and guardians accountable when they commit fraud. We have recovered over $10 million for local businesses through our efforts.
We have been successful in Eaton County because of our focus and determination to protect our citizens. I will take that same mindset to the Attorney General's office as we fight companies that deceptively charge junk fees, investigate those who take money without providing services, and crack down on healthcare billing fraud.
We also will reform the office to act faster on complaints and bring transparency to Michiganders so they know what to look out for.
I am also honored to be endorsed by the Michigan Retailers Association because they know they can count on me to make fighting organized retail crime a top priority. I have served on our state's Organized Retail Crime Advisory Board where I witnessed firsthand how these criminals drive up costs on law-abiding Michiganders with their theft and fraud.
Finally, we will take on black markets. While we have businesses selling items like [vapes](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h5RDsn5rT6olmVWrpQAuEs1mGPkqqdlLO4oMGxuGseIPfyO8ixYTDRLrE1R947tCjhLQ0RJ9ItRrvtKQp5bmIc2ub5AvOPDNaAArabwbCTPQmEmTx_961yu4n3tARQE5cGtDmQRr9vhikU1nMNxQ788VfvK4f3Z07DmgSbh8Wkw_xyVgiBxqCWzLH3xenfCWBUTL6U4-ABH7Db1AxZnuWqvO-YTXJ5fI1O-oSC6LxILkO-A02MLbVSn6HgMMB_21NN9guN2_FVA=&c=uAoMyEUJnO5JKu7FWV8b51sN5R-7aC8uzn_-7Exe2UEeGHNyv-dfGg==&ch=SBI1QDA6qTq3u4xVZjbUd8ypfjMEKe09lnZ9ke8uqmtePjw67hLPMQ==) and [marijuana](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h5RDsn5rT6olmVWrpQAuEs1mGPkqqdlLO4oMGxuGseIPfyO8ixYTDRLrE1R947tCl_sK2JDc_MNOzG7kMgffAHyFBq03_FQEl_dBf9HVLsJFzh2DsloLBl1RIBXjuQnS927-eiIZaPht-q6kcIlevhlmO45Gva0iQHCLvLpfKJD0I_seRTVsmd7RKJViNwulseanAQVmXwaPH0Q4LSV_tpTtWgiQJY42CswMgmvMkFRljdU4AfWL_aix1--FXKrAhLI_V8q2o2Ww7MSys3sIWZnbZSpYu93Q&c=uAoMyEUJnO5JKu7FWV8b51sN5R-7aC8uzn_-7Exe2UEeGHNyv-dfGg==&ch=SBI1QDA6qTq3u4xVZjbUd8ypfjMEKe09lnZ9ke8uqmtePjw67hLPMQ==), others, including organizations tied to China, are illegally growing and selling these legal products. These black markets hurt legal businesses, increase costs on the consumer, put Michiganders at physical risk, and short change our state revenues. We will aggressively prosecute anyone who operates illegally and protect our legal businesses that are doing business the right way.
My job as Attorney General will be to protect Michiganders, and that includes doing my part to bring down high costs that have been crushing families for too long. My record shows I am ready to do this the moment I take office.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecutor Republican Nominee for Attorney General

Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | Jacob Davis's Market Brief (ads) | • | Anchor Point Research ---|--- • | Salem Media Group • | Brownstone Research | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. ## Faculty Groups Sue Texas Tech
Two faculty groups sued Texas Tech Chancellor Brandon Creighton and the university system's regents on Wednesday over [rules restricting classroom instruction](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3unDAQxJ8GOiN_HSaFizR0_7Qp0R6sj5WMjewF7t4-4l4h3RQzP83M35_pByhSev2BDT2_Q54SXjUiM5bJPrYZ6gr7XpE54oaJZyiMk5a6F9IJJacFKH4m2y7-KZdfqkWv3GD6QRndt6t3Vppl0CG4wQGCcT047SwY8zAhGNWSv2HSKamU1NJ0IK0a9NAHa_rnQ2FjJS7EuXS8IuMbaoiffGLp5ry10a_Me23M70aPjR6v6-pCftt7xm1o9HjLRo_fqGCcV3EkOrFU4o8IMFN6iQhXPYjFzRVHmnOqTHww5QRRzPkoFUXBk_AS5YhY2-KX_aIYqfausfK1AcVvI_6_H0-v_wUAAP__N6uKfA) on race, sex, and gender identity. The federal suit, [filed in El Paso](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE9jMiPbeAw_cLAJ2d90Q9RjN4MlA5a7gc_tVzPaG2xUpQpelerP9_QNKaft9RtW9Pwz79OGF2VkxjrZxxqAFiiFkDnjihsHqIyTUcZJ1Uutpggp35Nton-q-KUb9LofOjfozrhm8drMrjODMk4psF8Rn_bx0DN2GAY1RNck_4apXiutlVFdC8rqwQxutp17PjQKqzAm3mvLCzL-AM353k-sbdjXJvuFuZDofgkzCjNe19VuAKHkOLd7fQkzlopEsmJGIBRmBDiK_IDkx8LMkg78FzGGRR5bOrFS4lvSTYyrfBfKisQ1BU4nyrAfld6yMW4sy55TSEjCjE31sVwp50SuF1a9Vkj5M5b_7-LTm78BAAD__wmXk9g) by the American Association of University Professors and its Texas affiliate, challenges two memos requiring professors to submit course material on those topics for regents' review. It asks a judge to block enforcement across the five-campus system. The groups argue the rules violate the First and Fourteenth Amendments and discriminate against black faculty. "_This is based on discrimination against populations that have ideas that the Chancellor finds to be disfavorable, and that is unconstitutional_ ," said Antonio Ingram, an attorney on the case. The Texas Tech System [said it is confident](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OhCAUBeCnwQ4DyIAWFNvYzbZbGn6uShbRwJ1x5u03zitsc29xki8n5-c-3W1MMS_fdgODr3mfMpw1ASKUSd42b-tqj6MCYoINMnpbECbBhKJMU86mYGN6T7IJxrEw8AYM132net4J1axGDko513caZm01V4rzwXkp7W0e5Mx0E82FMc0Z50ywrrVM8l70apadcjcORDIIEffS4goIL1vn9N6fUFq_b00yK-JRSfdFxEjEeJ5n--tduEIixssmYmT6Oj0R4wegCH6lbrcl0AILZKy0PiDQi6UFKpboMT6B-v1R6vUyQka6PGKAFDNUIsammHCcMaVYlSaSLZuN6VMK_zfl04i_AAAA__9gL4em) its policies are _"lawful, constitutionally sound, and fully compliant with state and federal law."_ Creighton, a former state senator, has defended the reviews as keeping coursework relevant for the workforce.
## Talarico, Paxton Announce Q2 Fundraising Totals
State Rep. James Talarico raised more than [$30 million for his U.S. Senate bid](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuS2zAQRE9DZqMCQJCCAwROlK1Th6wRMBBh4UMDs0vp9i76Cht31et-_ftj_cCYYnn8wkyWX6GuhY6eiJnaqufssG-4752YE2Uq7LAxrUqoBcQVpFg9xvRe9ejtXfgfciQrr2ZajJzUMm7WaCHcfdGzcT4E42YTwuK1mhVOJsxmjPaEiasUUgolpgsKLY0yS9DTcp8lDVqQj1zbhTdiemEP6V2_qF1czWOyG_Peh-nnoG6Duh3HcXkSP89wULfTZlC3P5ipA2PCFl2FhrFThxMCk4AcU4q1QCzQydXi4e_nqdnAYd4xPgp0fHfItRHwhgW4xT0RPKnAji-upUP_PPvGZv1-nLy-XActHhlj-j-Uv3fvl1X_AgAA__-UeZGG) from April through June, more than triple the $9 million reported by Attorney General Ken Paxton. Talarico's campaign called it the largest second-quarter haul ever by a Senate candidate in an election year, pushing his total past $70 million from 780,000 contributors since September. The campaign said 97% of donations were $100 or less. Paxton's camp touted its total as [the largest announced](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMlC7sYEJHFxCNpdeiHqgPfjWxshuDTN_v2J_YbMnlVSqev_u85188PvzL0W28nZp3vksgUU4z9rEhcpGx1FYJHDkXRbKwjMC9g0MjYJ5JR8-s65X-4D1pmq2ahi7flQd9vVmDTIaVqtzRM445dzNEQyEbqDVaKi9vcpgUKAUIHQtgVYjjr3TXf8wiisNvHpJuZWNhd9UXPikF-d2SbEOdhM5StX9qXCqcDrPs_3QltKVVjhddyqcjhS8-OVCyuKXwBf-p8ilEQqU_ZKaTL5wab54bw56S9obAK1xMKZvN4mhznY9Th-CL_1QaXhG8uFnhfzO3cvidwAAAP__pYGD0A) by any non-incumbent Republican Senate candidate this cycle, calling it a "clear signal that conservatives are rallying" behind him. Official reports identifying donors and cash on hand are due to the Federal Election Commission by July 15. [Recent public polling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DlvhDAUBOBfY3esfOGjcJGGbtOmRA94rC3ZgPDTHv8-2q3Sp57RJ838XMcr5JK32zdUjPRc93HDRytIhOdo-jpDS3AcDYkKVtxohpNwVELZTrhOinGBXF6j4UucxBIkxyid19ZLrSxPcQ291w40uhCC0kYqs2qrdZiWyQfjeY5vTDgppBRK6AsII73ydjXaTr1EZgQumfbzQgkJn9DW8trveF7mvfISE9HRmP5iamBqoIQpl_LOmBrSXvE9iKlhhnpAvm1MDX2wIrjQfbCu4QaEHUGBM89796fIz7gcj1xKbtYxI24V8ofm9L-z7lH9BgAA____FnyK) shows the race essentially tied.
## Texas Secures $45M Cash App Settlement
Cash App parent Block, Inc. [will pay $45 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ8GOqPxD4YULrahy7ZbImMPwZKNLTwJyduvSHMf4PbzzTnf-Xef7zbEsD_-2oSG3muedzxrRCI8ZtUnZ-tmS6lIFDHhTs4ehLMAoRkMjMPsbYifWbXeLOBvvEXDh1HqkUuh280oP4C4gQfvFMdFy5tbYNWLHJfeO4dtMNczGDhwDgJkZ0HxUYx6VVIvPcdGAfpA-ehoQ8K3rWv85BcencupjWYjKrWRfxoxNWI6z7Nb83uwz0phv04aMV1OjZi-MHOZRbS-MtWzFGIMeWc_fuwyZrYUdkUwjw4LhReyiu55BPowF21ItT2ML-eFVz00Ch7JhvhtRL_b8WXE_wAAAP__Z4WJ7Q) to settle a 46-state investigation co-led by Texas into claims it misled users about fraud protections. Texas will receive [nearly $5 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO3DAMQE8jdxpIlEafwkUad5s2pUFL9FhY-QObGc_ePvAkQA6w5SOBB_L9-ug_sNSyPH7iTC2_xrVf6DwqMdPe2_uc8Jhw2w5irjTTwgl3ph4UOKm81KrPWOpXb5vcDipH3VCrfTAuaAOumdqc4kDe2eitQoDoI7pAASFon81gmtJeMuW10lqBMjdUVgcIbrTGDXdNwirKhdf9xhMxvfAY69f6pP2W1rmp7cS8HcL8ENAJ6M7zvH0-f9O1FNDhziVVEtBdfwnoDka-8C2S_4Z_AR9yHceSSH7SIjd88brIK4DEbZP_EwjowEVpTfCeRi-VvYO0TieJ4JPMYXAmRjv6ITZ7m7ez1FoO54VVjxlLfd_N36v9bOFPAAAA__8HfpDM). Investigators said the company marketed the payment app as a safe, bank-like alternative while fraud outpaced its safeguards, leaving victims with no way to recover stolen funds. Within 30 days, Block must provide 24-hour customer support, simplify fraud reporting, and post scam warnings inside the app. A linked federal consent order requires consumer refunds of between $75 million and $120 million. "_This settlement ensures that Texans who were harmed can recover what they are owed_ ," [Paxton said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAQRb9GdxhARFywmE3v3mxnaaqluiWDQKCe2n8_sTP9BW9XqZyq3Hv-fM1f4IOPz9-woaXzkeaIRw1IhGVWw7ZAXSHnikQBN4y0QCGcJZea8ZEJPjvw4TWr1tk7d5No0YrR9NqIXup2tYMx0ySF4kYgKI14n0AOWrtlVIbj1Hp7PeOj4EJwyfsOuBJGGv1Qvb4PAhvF0XlKpaMVCU-oj_BKO5ZuSVsb7EqUa9P_auStkbfjOLo3BESpRHw9MWKB0D3T3sjb1a6Rt4IBoeI1fjj2H2R_MbIMJ6XIKi7fBStTA9t8CP69-phglxsGObPdL-S3yvDMqaJjjwLfjkF0bbEuH9dl1WOj-HMDH96x6Weydyv_BQAA__8cTJej). Block denied wrongdoing, saying it settled solely to close the matter.

body:

| [ |

---
|
---
| **President Donald J. Trump** and the **Republican National Committee** have announced the details for the **2026 Republican Mid-term National Convention** in **Dallas, TX, September 9 and 10.**

This is the first Mid-term National Convention in Republican Party history. President Trump believes it is important for winning Congressional elections and other elections this November. And he’s said on the record that **this Convention will be a** **“once-in-a-lifetime experience.”**

This Mid-term Convention will be different than standard presidential-election year conventions. The Republican National Committee has delegated selection of attendees to the various State Parties. But **the timeline to make these selections is tight** : State Parties have until **July 15** to submit their attendee lists to the RNC.

For best-possible speed and fairness, the WAGOP is distributing most of its convention tickets through **a** **modified Dutch auction** (also known as a **“sealed-bid, descending price”** auction). Bids start at $125 but can go as high as each bidder chooses. Republicans interested in attending the 2026 Mid-term Convention, can make a non-refundable bid at this link: [Support - Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP).](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=31141&L=15988&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS93YWdvcC8yYmE4ZjI2Ni1iNzk1LTQ4ZTgtYjQ4MS05ZGZkNzI4MWRhYTg/dXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01UUXhOVGcxTWpRJTNE&hash=e8323a4cb98bc6eb74fdb94cf08ad9c307cab37533493c82eb78d73e7f5b408f)

WAGOP will distribute tickets based on **bids received by 6 p.m. on Tuesday evening, July 14**.
Bidders can place multiple bids, if they wish—but **all bids are non-refundable**.

NOTE: These tickets admit individuals to the 2026 Republican Mid-term National Convention. **They do NOT include travel or accommodations** in Dallas—and the RNC is requiring attendees to stay at designated Mid-term Convention hotels in Dallas. More details on those accommodations will be available after the attendee lists from each state are finalized.

WAGOP is continuing to get questions about how people can attend the 2026 Mid-Term National Convention. This modified Dutch auction is the answer. If you’re interested and inclined, [click here](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=31141&L=15988&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS93YWdvcC8yYmE4ZjI2Ni1iNzk1LTQ4ZTgtYjQ4MS05ZGZkNzI4MWRhYTg/dXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01UUXhOVGcxTWpRJTNE&hash=e8323a4cb98bc6eb74fdb94cf08ad9c307cab37533493c82eb78d73e7f5b408f) and bid. This is the most direct way to **join President Trump, Vice President J.D. Vance and the rest of the Republican Party** in Dallas this September!

Thanks.

Jim Walsh, Chairman
Washington State Republican Party

body:
Trump is intentionally creating chaos ahead of the midterm elections, chaos that he intends to capitalize on to rig the outcome.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_EzWwvZbtjzS2560fSsD-jQJQTnriJZ77wCjdA9_hBuD5t6o8xiwzB7ZedxKRJS3ovT7Gy-sh1zaXeCgoYs0Y-AHxzcI-JD16qgW5egCNl4ePm4XFuKDT4f2JvQeypCyYeCdqBNiCRL0_wMs7LqBuQeBwghOLFVlrsUm7p4eopYQn7Jf-61JtNYgxEuJCV1Ozlb_YC-xnIuFfQMtL-OifqfiJ85ss8hQ&c=GyC7IM4Kft7QiE9-hvD-uVqN--X-tUbnCeujjSX5XhX1A68dHzp6uA==&ch=lo3lID4G4Mloem2uGq12T8DviSWhPaR7-W-Eg8HE_vg_QRM1wRr2dw==)
---
|
Peter,
Just weeks ago, the Supreme Court issued a ruling in Trump v. Slaughter that overturned nearly a decade of precedent, expanding the power of the president and allowing him to fire leaders of independent federal agencies without cause.
Now, Trump has made his first firings with this newfound power--and he went straight after the commissioners responsible for overseeing elections.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_EzWwvZbtjzS2560fSsD-jQJQTnriJZ77wCjdA9_hBuD5t6o8xiwzB7ZedxKRJS3ovT7Gy-sh1zaXeCgoYs0Y-AHxzcI-JD16qgW5egCNl4ePm4XFuKDT4f2JvQeypCyYeCdqBNiCRL0_wMs7LqBuQeBwghOLFVlrsUm7p4eopYQn7Jf-61JtNYgxEuJCV1Ozlb_YC-xnIuFfQMtL-Oifm_37HO209hY&c=GyC7IM4Kft7QiE9-hvD-uVqN--X-tUbnCeujjSX5XhX1A68dHzp6uA==&ch=lo3lID4G4Mloem2uGq12T8DviSWhPaR7-W-Eg8HE_vg_QRM1wRr2dw==)
---
This is absolutely horrifying. It is by far his most blatant election rigging attempt yet.
The Election Assistance Commission (EAC) is an independent federal agency tasked with assisting states with administering elections--developing voting system guidelines, accrediting testing labs and certifying voting equipment, distributing election funds to states, and publishing reports on how states run elections.
By firing the commissioners, the agency can no longer legally act just months before the midterm elections. Meaning it can't certify new voting equipment many states require, and its bipartisan oversight of elections collapses.
Trump is intentionally creating chaos ahead of the midterm elections, chaos that he intends to capitalize on to rig the outcome.
This is exactly what Defend Our Courts has been sounding the alarm about for years. That's why we've been leading the effort to rapidly build a firewall of state supreme courts, the courts with final say on election law in their states, to defend free and fair elections from Trump's fascist ambitions.
And none of this would be possible without the Supreme Court's blessing. We've been leading the way on that front as well, pushing for SCOTUS reform. Democrats must expand the number of justices on the Court and reclaim the majority before they can undo our democracy and usher in an era of MAGA fascism.
Things are getting serious. If we have any hope of stopping Trump's from dismantling our Democracy, we are going to have to double our efforts. And we need you by our side for this fight:
[Peter, it's do or die. Democracy is on the line. Will you join the over 100,000 Democrats who have chipped in to support our defense of free and fair elections by rushing a contribution of $50, $25, or whatever you can spare right now?](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_EzWwvZbtjzS2560fSsD-jQJQTnriJZ77wCjdA9_hBuD5t6o8xiwzB7ZedxKRJS3Fya0qh6Xw_rBSMOdTbNOBhVAkoabCa-FI5Eop2Mn3f7888c2VQymsyUgpAHPymViAz4X2pHYGxdIgb409QbxOkoXvdDVmM2J6ICrGp9unZvuOm2jU-xjaCITIaOSwYswauO60S3o3d7oT0wCqTB_0g_j5IgAgIUSHL-GnDBw3psUuNPTFl-Xbg==&c=GyC7IM4Kft7QiE9-hvD-uVqN--X-tUbnCeujjSX5XhX1A68dHzp6uA==&ch=lo3lID4G4Mloem2uGq12T8DviSWhPaR7-W-Eg8HE_vg_QRM1wRr2dw==)

clean_body: Trump is intentionally creating chaos ahead of the midterm elections, chaos that he intends to capitalize on to rig the outcome. | | | | | == | Peter, Just weeks ago, the Supreme Court issued a ruling in Trump v. Slaughter that overturned nearly a decade of precedent, expanding the power of the president and allowing him to fire leaders of independent federal agencies without cause. Now, Trump has made his first firings with this newfound power--and he went straight after the commissioners responsible for overseeing elections. | == This is absolutely horrifying. It is by far his most blatant election rigging attempt yet. The Election Assistance Commission (EAC) is an independent federal agency tasked with assisting states with administering elections--developing voting system guidelines, accrediting testing labs and certifying voting equipment, distributing election funds to states, and publishing reports on how states run elections. By firing the commissioners, the agency can no longer legally act just months before the midterm elections. Meaning it can't certify new voting equipment many states require, and its bipartisan oversight of elections collapses. Trump is intentionally creating chaos ahead of the midterm elections, chaos that he intends to capitalize on to rig the outcome. This is exactly what Defend Our Courts has been sounding the alarm about for years. That's why we've been leading the effort to rapidly build a firewall of state supreme courts, the courts with final say on election law in their states, to defend free and fair elections from Trump's fascist ambitions. And none of this would be possible without the Supreme Court's blessing. We've been leading the way on that front as well, pushing for SCOTUS reform. | Letter from the Chair
---
The Enemy Within - Communism
As we read almost daily about Communists, or their alias "progressive socialists", who among us could imagine that we would face this threat to our government and way of life here in Nebraska. This definitely wouldn't have been on my bingo card five years ago. We have seen over the last several years that the Democrat Party has swung more and more to the left; this is the result.
Here in Nebraska we have two Democrat Socialists of America chapters, one in Lincoln and one in Omaha. What was touted as socialism has made its natural evolution into Communism as evidenced in states such as New York, Colorado, Maine, and Montana, with additional activity in states like Michigan, Florida, California, Oregon, Arizona, Georgia, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Vermont, Utah, Maryland, Texas, and yes, here in Nebraska.
The Democrat Party of our parents' and grandparents' day is not the Democrat Party of today and their party is being taken over from within. Two new offshoots of the Democrat Party are being formed in Nebraska as we speak - The Nebraska Working Families Party and the America First Party. There are two reasons or this: one is that these parties want to be the vanguard for a more rapid decline/takeover of the rabid left of the Nebraska Democrat Party. Two is that the recent SCOTUS ruling that removed limits for State Parties to directly coordinate with federal candidates.
Each Political Party can accept $10,000 per individual and use that money in coordination with federal candidates. The NEGOP will be following closely who funds these new parties and who benefits from them. If you have three parties supporting one candidate, that would be $30,000 from each individual donor and thus amplify the money that candidate can receive from a single source.
We are under threat in Nebraska from posers who want to wear the mantle of non-partisan like Dan Osborn (against Senator Pete Ricketts), Austin Ahlman (against Congressman Mike Flood), and Brent Comstock (against Regent candidate Jeremy Hosein). I would also include "Dark Money Denise Powell (running against CD2 candidate Brinker Harding) in this group.
Fortunately, more moderate Democrats saw the radical leftist leanings of Kara Eastman and Tony Vargas and helped to keep Congressman Don Bacon in office. We can only hope that they will do so again.
Many of our party are still sleepwalking through elections and don't see that we have an existential threat to our way of life here in Nebraska. The NEGOP will do its best to keep the spotlight on this threat, but it will take all of us to work together against it.
The Republican Party has had poor turnout in recent elections and we cannot allow that to happen again. Not showing up to vote is silent consent to the radical communist takeover of our state. I do not exaggerate. As the adage goes, "You can vote yourself into Communism, but you have to shoot your way out of Communism".
Those of us in the NEGOP are working together to do our part to stave off the threat, but it will take all of us educating our families, friends, and neighbors to what is going on. We are fighting an enemy that seeks power by any means under the guise of "equality" or "justice". What they don't say is that they are fighting to make us all equally poor and equally yoked to a ruling class.
Consider this a challenge to all who read this message. We are the vanguard.

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair The Enemy Within - Communism As we read almost daily about Communists, or their alias "progressive socialists", who among us could imagine that we would face this threat to our government and way of life here in Nebraska. This definitely wouldn't have been on my bingo card five years ago. We have seen over the last several years that the Democrat Party has swung more and more to the left; this is the result. Here in Nebraska we have two Democrat Socialists of America chapters, one in Lincoln and one in Omaha. What was touted as socialism has made its natural evolution into Communism as evidenced in states such as New York, Colorado, Maine, and Montana, with additional activity in states like Michigan, Florida, California, Oregon, Arizona, Georgia, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Vermont, Utah, Maryland, Texas, and yes, here in Nebraska. The Democrat Party of our parents' and grandparents' day is not the Democrat Party of today and their party is being taken over from within. Two new offshoots of the Democrat Party are being formed in Nebraska as we speak - The Nebraska Working Families Party and the America First Party. There are two reasons or this: one is that these parties want to be the vanguard for a more rapid decline/takeover of the rabid left of the Nebraska Democrat Party. Two is that the recent SCOTUS ruling that removed limits for State Parties to directly coordinate with federal candidates. Each Political Party can accept $10,000 per individual and use that money in coordination with federal candidates. The NEGOP will be following closely who funds these new parties and who benefits from them. If you have three parties supporting one candidate, that would be $30,000 from each individual donor and thus amplify the money that candidate can receive from a single source. We are under threat in Nebraska from posers who want to wear the mantle of non-partisan like Dan Osborn (against Senator Pete Ricketts), Austin Ahlman (against Congressman Mike Flood), and Brent Comstock (against Regent candidate Jeremy Hosein). I would also include "Dark Money Denise Powell (running against CD2 candidate Brinker Harding) in this group. Fortunately, more moderate Democrats saw the radical leftist leanings of Kara Eastman and Tony Vargas and helped to keep Congressman Don Bacon in office. We can only hope that they will do so again. Many of our party are still sleepwalking through elections and don't see that we have an existential threat to our way of life here in Nebraska. The NEGOP will do its best to keep the spotlight on this threat, but it will take all of us to work together against it. The Republican Party has had poor turnout in recent elections and we cannot allow that to happen again. Not showing up to vote is silent consent to the radical communist takeover of our state. I do not exaggerate. As the adage goes, "You can vote yourself into Communism, but you have to shoot your way out of Communism". Those of us in the NEGOP are working together to do our part to stave off the threat, but it will take all of us educating our families, friends, and neighbors to what is going on. We are fighting an enemy that seeks power by any means under the guise of "equality" or "justice". What they don't say is that they are fighting to make us all equally poor and equally yoked to a ruling class. Consider this a challenge to all who read this message. We are the vanguard. Peter,

Today, I’m asking you to make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina. If that’s all you need to hear, you can use this link to chip in:

# No summer vacation for this campaign

Peter,They call these the dog days of summer, the stretch where everybody is supposed to be dozing in a hammock somewhere.
Not us.
With the primary bearing down on us in August, we have got one of the busiest calendars of the whole campaign packed into these next few days.
---
| [CHIP IN NOW TO HELP US COVER ALL THIS GROUND](https://us.list-manage.com/pZSxBrz8Vum?e=0c0d11993f&c2id=6a676d78c90e8a1f5821c8d4ac39abd8)
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**Here is where we will be:**
**Friday, July 10, River Falls Days Parade.** Marching with the Pierce County Democrats starting at 6 pm. Come wave, come holler, come walk with us.
**Saturday, July 11, Northern WI State Fair, Chippewa Falls.** Stop by and find me in Building C with the Chippewa County Dems anytime from 10am to 9pm. Fair food is on you.
---
| [VIEW EVENT DETAILS]()
---
| |
**Sunday, July 12, Fun Fest Parade, New Richmond.** Back on the parade route in my own hometown at 1pm. Come out and say hi.
**Monday, July 13, a doubleheader.** Noon finds me at the Wausau Noon Optimists Club alongside the other CD7 candidates from both parties.
Then I am headed to the Wood County Dems Picnic in Pittsville from 5 to 8 pm, with food, music from Aarochele, and a chance to hear from me and other candidates.
All this driving from one end of the district to the other adds up, and gas is not free.
If you want to help keep the tank full and the wheels turning through these final weeks, a few bucks tossed our way makes a difference. [Every dollar goes straight into showing up in one more town.](https://us.list-manage.com/gUjVPInLFzv?e=0c0d11993f&c2id=6a676d78c90e8a1f5821c8d4ac39abd8)
Come find me out there. I would love to shake your hand.
Thanks, Chris ~:|

clean_body: With the primary bearing down on us in August, we have got one of the busiest calendars of the whole campaign packed into these next few days. | | | | | | | | | | | | | No summer vacation for this campaign Peter,They call these the dog days of summer, the stretch where everybody is supposed to be dozing in a hammock somewhere. Not us. With the primary bearing down on us in August, we have got one of the busiest calendars of the whole campaign packed into these next few days. | | | | | | | | | | | | | Here is where we will be: Friday, July 10, River Falls Days Parade. Marching with the Pierce County Democrats starting at 6 pm. Come wave, come holler, come walk with us. Saturday, July 11, Northern WI State Fair, Chippewa Falls. Stop by and find me in Building C with the Chippewa County Dems anytime from 10am to 9pm. Fair food is on you. | [VIEW EVENT DETAILS]() | | Sunday, July 12, Fun Fest Parade, New Richmond. Back on the parade route in my own hometown at 1pm. Come out and say hi. Monday, July 13, a doubleheader. Noon finds me at the Wausau Noon Optimists Club alongside the other CD7 candidates from both parties. Then I am headed to the Wood County Dems Picnic in Pittsville from 5 to 8 pm, with food, music from Aarochele, and a chance to hear from me and other candidates. All this driving from one end of the district to the other adds up, and gas is not free. If you want to help keep the tank full and the wheels turning through these final weeks, a few bucks tossed our way makes a difference. Come find me out there. I would love to shake your hand. Thanks, Chris ~:| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Our mailing address is: P.O. Box 323, New Richmond, WI 54017 Want to change how you receive these emails? Dear Patriot,
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)I'm Shane Cory. I'm a United States Marine Corps veteran, and I've spent 27 years fighting government corruption — long enough to learn exactly how the machine protects itself. I lead **Project Hostem, a project of Liberty Guard** , and our whole approach comes from something I learned in uniform. America has long trained and equipped local forces overseas to take on entrenched, corrupt power. We rarely did the fighting for them — **we found the people already willing to fight** , gave them the tools and the training, and let them win their own war. By, with, and through the locals. It's the most effective model there is. **When we withdraw, our benefits stay for decades.** [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[→ FUND A CITIZEN ARMY OF CORRUPTION FIGHTERS — GIVE $35](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** So I asked a simple question: Why not bring that home — **legally** , nonviolently, in broad daylight — against the corruption rotting our own counties and statehouses? **That's Project Hostem.** We don't parachute into your town and grandstand. We find the citizens already fed up — the moms, the veterans, the small-business owners — and we train them in the real tools: public records law, grand jury rights, courtroom procedure, media pressure. Then we hand them the keys. **The community owns the fight.** We provide the special-operations capability. [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[→ FUND A CITIZEN ARMY OF CORRUPTION FIGHTERS — GIVE $35](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Here's what 27 years taught me: the corrupt official isn't afraid of an angry letter or a viral post. He's afraid of a trained citizen who knows the rules better than he does and won't go away. One of those is a nuisance. **A hundred of them, in a hundred counties, is the end of business as usual.** [**Your gift doesn't fund an abstraction**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) — it funds an outcome you'll feel close to home: More trained citizens standing watch over your local government, which means fewer sweetheart deals, less waste of your tax dollars, and officials who finally know someone is paying attention. A community defended by its own people is a safer, stronger, freer place to live and raise a family. That's what your support builds — **one trained neighbor at a time.** The grievances are real. The laws already exist. The only thing missing has been the training to use them. [**Let's put it in your neighbors' hands.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[→ YES — I'LL HELP TRAIN THE NEXT WAVE](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
In the fight,Shane Cory Founder & President, Project Hostem United States Marine Corps Veteran
27 Years Fighting Government Corruption
P.S. _The same doctrine our country uses to equip rebels against tyrants overseas works against the petty tyrants at the county building — with subpoenas instead of rifles. I've spent 27 years proving it.[**Help me scale it. Donate today.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)_

Fellow Patriot, We need to show you something James Talarico said in his primary night victory speech in March. **_"We already know who we're running against: The billionaire megadonors and their corrupt political system."_** Now let me show you what he did six weeks later. According to a bombshell report published by _POLITICO_ , James Talarico quietly flew to San Francisco and spent three days, April 15th through April 17th, attending at least four private fundraisers with Silicon Valley billionaires, venture capitalists, and tech industry insiders. Palo Alto. The Mission District. Oakland. Marin County. Four fundraisers. Three days. One lie. The same man who built his campaign on a promise to fight billionaire influence in politics was, at that very moment, sitting in the living rooms of Silicon Valley's wealthiest Democratic donors, asking them for money. clean_body: Rules for thee, not for me The hypocrisy Rules for thee, not for me | | | | | | | Fellow Patriot, We need to show you something James Talarico said in his primary night victory speech in March. "We already know who we're running against: The billionaire megadonors and their corrupt political system." Now let me show you what he did six weeks later. According to a bombshell report published by POLITICO , James Talarico quietly flew to San Francisco and spent three days, April 15th through April 17th, attending at least four private fundraisers with Silicon Valley billionaires, venture capitalists, and tech industry insiders. Palo Alto. The Mission District. Oakland. Marin County. Four fundraisers. Three days. One lie. The same man who built his campaign on a promise to fight billionaire influence in politics was, at that very moment, sitting in the living rooms of Silicon Valley's wealthiest Democratic donors, asking them for money. He did not tell you. He did not announce it. POLITICO obtained private invitation copies just to find out it happened. And it gets worse. On top of those secret fundraisers, two super PACs, Moment of Truth PAC and Lone Star Rising PAC, have pledged to spend massively on Talarico's behalf. The same candidate who has called for banning super PACs is the direct beneficiary of super PAC money flooding into this race. Talarico's own campaign previously admitted he took PAC money in his last race, too, saying he would not "unilaterally disarm." In other words, the rules he demands for everyone else do not apply to him when his own career is on the line. Here is the full picture of what we are dealing with. Talarico has raised over $40 million. He has nearly $10 million in cash on hand. It has been estimated that this race could consume more than $550 million total before November. Silicon Valley, Wall Street, and every liberal super PAC in America have decided that flipping Texas is worth whatever it costs. And the man leading that effort spent three days in San Francisco telling billionaires exactly that while telling you he was fighting for working Texans. Ken Paxton has spent over a decade fighting for the people of Texas in court, on the border, and against every political force that tried to take him down, including the $100 million establishment assault he defeated just to win the Republican nomination. But right now, the cash gap is nearly $8 million. And with the FEC quarterly deadline closing at midnight on June 30th, the number we file in the next few days is the first signal to the entire country about whether Ken can compete. Peter — When it comes to Florida’s soaring utility bills, I’m often asked: _"How would you lower my costs as attorney general?"_ It's a fair question, and the answer starts with understanding how this actually works. Your utility bills don't go up on their own. They go up through Tallahassee. State government sets the rules, and the Public Service Commission is the body that approves every single rate increase. Most of us live in areas served by the giant utilities that lobby heavily in Tallahassee, and over the last few decades, our light bills have gone _up, and up, and up._ As Attorney General, **I will intervene on our behalf to fight rate increases and argue for rate reductions before the Public Service Commission. And when utilities unfairly bill Florida families, I'll investigate and bring legal action to recover that money.** That's not some radical idea. It's the work attorneys general do across the country. But here in Florida, we have the opposite: an Attorney General who serves the special interests in Tallahassee instead of the people paying the bills. Right now, roughly half the state — _families and businesses served by Florida Power & Light_ — is facing **$7 billion in rate increases.** And James Uthmeier hasn't lifted a finger to stop it. **[We need an Attorney General who will fight for us, not against us. Every year we go without one, the utilities get bolder, the rate hikes get bigger, and Florida families fall further behind. I'm running to put an end to that. | | | | | | Dear Peter,

We won the primary — and we won it big, thanks to rural New Mexico. Hobbs, Artesia, Roswell, Carlsbad, Farmington, Lovington — you showed up. I have always stood with our farmers, ranchers, and oil and gas workers, and I always will. This win belongs to you.

Now the general election fight begins, and the choice couldn't be clearer.

Deb Haaland spent years in Washington restricting oil and gas leasing on federal land and co-sponsoring the Green New Deal — while southeast New Mexico's oil and gas industry pays for our schools, roads, and police. Without that industry, there is no New Mexico budget. Period.

Meanwhile, cartel-driven fentanyl pours across our border, rural land becomes smuggling routes, and Santa Fe responds with lectures instead of leadership. New Mexico deserves a Lieutenant Governor who defends this state's economy and its people — not one who spent her career working against both.

I didn't win this primary to play it safe. I won it to finish the job. But Haaland and the Democrat money machine are already gearing up, and they'll spend whatever it takes.

**Do you agree New Mexico must remain an energy state?

Do you agree we must secure our border?

Do you agree working families shouldn't be sacrificed to Washington ideology?

**If the answer is yes - I need you in this fight. Will you chip in $500, $1000, $2500, or $5000 today to help us take New Mexico back?

Two pieces of good news, then the healthcare fight.
* * *
### Duke drops from 18% to 11.6%
Four weeks ago, I told you I was pushing back against Duke Energy because they're trying to raise rates.
They wanted an 18% hike on residential customers (that means you).
So we filed 700 pages worth of documents from our own independent study to show that they were asking for much more than they needed.
The folks who make the final decision are the Utilities Commission, which just started hearing our case.
But a few days before we started, something interesting happened.
Duke announced that, due to the pushback they received, they were lowering their request from 18% to 11.6%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d528348f-23ed-451b-bc85-6159e66c6074?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That's still a hike, and still more than we think they need, but it's a major move and it tells the Commission something important:
Duke's first number was nowhere close to reasonable.
The hearing is underway, and now we've got more momentum than we had a week ago. I'll report back.
### Lots of eggs!
We just got **three million eggs** donated to North Carolina food banks.
_How?_
Because three major egg producers coordinated to inflate egg prices, we caught them, and part of the settlement requires that they directly help people with this donation.
But there's more: The whole country gets 53 million eggs, there's also a fine they have to pay, and now those egg producers will operate under strict oversight.
What does strict oversight look like?
Like this:
Each company will now have an antitrust compliance officer that we approve. That officer will audit the company's egg price bidding twice a year, sit in on _any industry meeting where egg prices might come up,_ and report any violation to us within thirty days.
So it's more than just our 3m eggs, but that should help tens of thousands of families in NC - _and_ _we stopped the companies from rigging the market._
### Our new healthcare fight
We just filed a lawsuit to protect health insurance for **tens of thousands of the most severely ill North Carolinians.**
People with cancer, cystic fibrosis, muscular dystrophy, kidney disease, ALS, MS, hemophilia, and a long list of other serious illnesses have specific legal protection, and we're going to court to enforce it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e042576b-c7cf-4537-b5c7-a12a9a805fbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's what happened:
Last year, Congress passed new work requirements for folks who get Medicaid, which is our main program for providing health insurance to low-income citizens.
_BUT_ Congress specifically exempted people with very serious illnesses because if they're unable to work due to their illness, Congress didn't want them losing their healthcare.
_BUT THEN -_ and here's the problem - the federal Medicaid agency just decided not to listen to Congress on that.
They basically said, "Instead of protecting this group like Congress told us to, we're going to narrow that protection, we're going to make it harsher, and we're going to create a big risk that they get kicked off their health insurance, even while they're actively being treated for one of the worst illnesses you can have."
And that, they can't do. They don't have the power. Congress was specific: They wanted seriously ill people protected. The agency broke the law when it ignored that.
And there's another problem.
The agency changed course at the last minute, after leading states to believe they would follow the law as Congress wrote it. North Carolina has already spent millions preparing for the lawful version of the rule. If this new version goes through, much of that work gets wasted.
And for patients, doctors, and county social services offices, this creates a mountain of new red tape: more medical evaluations, more forms, more appointments, more paperwork, and more chances for someone who is very sick to get knocked off coverage because a bureaucracy missed something.
This is not about fraud - my office goes after Medicaid fraud all the time. We just announced another win on a Medicaid fraud case today, in a case we did alongside U.S. Attorney Dan Bishop (who was a great partner on the case).
But this is about a bureaucracy that wants to grow for the sake of its own growth, and at the expense of some very sick people. We're not going to allow that.
So we've filed a lawsuit and asked the court to treat this as an emergency. We should know something within a matter of weeks.
As you can understand, I'm hearing from a lot of people whose families could be affected by this, and they're scared.
I get it.
But here's what I'm telling them:
_You let me worry about this._ You focus on getting better, on taking care of your family, and you let me handle this fight for you.
We're on the right side, and we've got your back.
Best,
Jeff

NYT: Trump Signs Order Seeking Federal Control of Mail Voting as He Promotes False Claims [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=071026_1&amount=25]
Straight from the New York Times , Team:
" President Trump stepped up efforts to promote his false claims of widespread voting fraud, signing an executive order of questionable constitutionality seeking to create a national list of citizens that would determine voting eligibility and restrict mail ballots. "
Let's be clear: The president has no explicit Constitutional authority over elections, and much of this latest attack on our fundamental right to vote appears difficult to enforce and legally dubious.
This order directs the Department of Homeland Security to create a “ state citizenship list ” based on data from various federal databases. It also directs federal officials to send that made-up list to state election officials, and orders the attorney general to prioritize prosecution of election officials who provide ballots to voters not on the made-up list. It also directs the U.S. Postal Service not to transmit mail-in ballots from any individual not included on Trump's “ state citizenship list ," even though elections are mandated by the constitutional the be run by the states.
This order is yet another sign that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
Our elections are sound and mail-in voting is secure, no matter what Trump says. Step up to defend our fundamental right to vote and the use of mail-in ballots with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=071026_1&amount=35]
