Where choosing to follow Christ could cost you your family, your job, or your freedom. Where a missionary can’t get a visa.For millions of people, this is not a hypothetical. It is everyday life.This summer, many of them are coming to the World Cup.They are coming to cheer for their national team and experience something larger than themselves. When they arrive in cities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, they will step into something they never experienced before — a place where someone can walk up to them, hand them a Gospel of John in their language, and tell them about Jesus without anyone stopping it._This moment is what we are preparing for._ IMB teams will be on the ground in Fan Zones and near stadiums throughout the tournament. Trained volunteers will be ready to have conversations, distribute resources, and connect fans with digital discipleship tools in their language that they can take home — back to countries where that kind of follow-up would otherwise be impossible.For some of these fans, this will be the only time in their lives they are handed the gospel freely.We cannot show up unprepared.You can help us be ready by giving a gift today.Here is what your gift does:

* $50 — 25 soccer patches for sparking evangelistic conversations
* $100 — 100 Gospel of John booklets
* $250 — Rents an English Club outreach location where fans can hear the gospel in a welcoming space

At the Paris Olympics and the Winter Olympics, this approach worked. Thousands of spiritual conversations occurred. Tens of thousands of New Testaments were distributed. People made commitments to Christ during conversations with our teams. People interested in the gospel connected with discipleship tools that followed them home to their own countries.The World Cup is far-reaching. The opportunity to connect with people who have never had access to hear the gospel is greater than anything we have seen at a single event.But only if we are there, fully funded and fully prepared.**Will you give today to ensure our teams are on the ground and ready for the World Cup?**[Click here to give.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_Iak_A3vE3uVASREtIbJ4_yqLLZzWvy-c8Fh4nEfe1aNW00U0eEf3ZdmRcfUdNLTvpTOlvfpx4yiyInjMyrgzgUU1-ZBmvb6jlTZ1Hqb6eYV3_8fGmGRn3iaJHkW1pef7taIPgQBn1ZqO8Awdj-qHcSEc1akl67V5tc6NoRY0MF3IRtQv_VsjVqVXrF5eV2hokw8I_T5Rm0W2OmfUa1rMBWWbxq1daF8bDwiBmETce2JSzecZBrKqcbEeJWX6_E-2ypHvG0YM3qGn5N1CnWOJW7QDN9fXLXv8MQAfcLoJYk9QF53BybsiVm4ETZhR6cAfw/4s7/8xyO-hF7T8OQddVin9DaFw/h2/h001.aAlNZbUiLDTHFy0a-1cVvgEXxue_yfnBQ0u-FsratOQ)Grateful for you,

name: Phil Weiser
subject: My “why”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/4217?t=1001&akid=129%2E245147%2EkY9hD4 ][IMG]

Hi Derek,
Phil here — Colorado’s Attorney General, and the official Democratic
nominee for Colorado’s next governor.

Before I ask you to [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/4217?t=1002&akid=129%2E245147%2EkY9hD4 ]split a contribution between our grassroots General
Election Fund and Josh Shapiro, I want to introduce myself and explain why
I hope to earn your support.

I came to Colorado over 30 years ago for a job interview, and that
decision changed my life forever. It was here that my wife, Heidi, and I
raised our two wonderful kids — three, if you count our
mostly-well-behaved dog, Zeke.

I’ve dedicated my life to public service. And, as the son and grandson of
Holocaust survivors, I’m committed to our shared American values of
liberty, justice, and the idea that all people should live free from
discrimination, hatred, and oppression.

My first job after law school was here in Colorado, and it launched my
career that included clerking for Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader
Ginsberg, working for President Obama, and serving as the Dean of the
University of Colorado Law School. From that first job to now, I have
always believed that Colorado is the best place to live and the ideal
place to raise a family.

I love this state,
Derek. And when you love
something, you fight for it.

My commitment to fight for Colorado is why I don’t get it when others try
to appease and give in to bullies like the President and his cabinet. It
does not work, and it’s not what leaders do. Not now, not ever. We must
take a stand, not be afraid, and not back down.

I know fighting for what’s right isn’t easy. Fights worth having rarely
are.

As the People’s Lawyer, I’ve had a lot of practice in these fights. It’s
been my job to enforce the rule of law, and no one is above it: not
deceitful corporations, not abusive employers, and definitely not the
federal government. In fact, as part of upholding the rule of law, I’ve
taken the Trump administration to court 67 times (and counting) — and
we’re winning again and again.

I’m proud of the reputation I’ve built here in Colorado,
Derek. I’m not here to do
“politics as usual”. I’m here to fight for you, not the powerful or
wealthy few. And I am always going to show up, listen, and deliver for all
of Colorado.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/4217?t=1003&akid=129%2E245147%2EkY9hD4 ]I refuse to let billionaire money cloud our agenda of freedom,
affordability, and opportunity. That means I’m relying on committed
supporters like you to help us meet our goal of 2,000 individual
contributions. I’d be honored if you’d split a donation of any amount
between this campaign and Josh Shapiro today.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation between Phil Weiser and Josh Shapiro will go through immediately:

With gratitude,

Phil

Peter,
Donald Trump recently sent FBI agents to Wisconsin to question our election officials about the 2020 presidential election. Yes, you read that right — _six years later,_ and he still can’t get over it.
This isn’t the first time we’ve seen Trump use his executive power to undermine our democratic elections.

But a bill doesn't become law without a Senate majority willing to pass it.
**That’s why flipping the Senate blue this November is so, so important.** Winning back the majority gives us a crucial check on Trump's power — and stops this from becoming normal.

Should members of Congress be allowed to buy and sell individual stocks while making decisions that can move markets?
I don't think so.
While most Americans don't get access to private briefings, inside information, or advance knowledge of government actions, members of Congress do.
It’s no wonder so many people have lost faith in Washington. They look at the headlines, see politicians outperforming the market, and wonder whether the system is rigged for the powerful.
That's why I introduced legislation to ban members of Congress and their spouses from trading individual stocks while serving in office — because elected officials should be focused on serving the people who sent them to Washington, not managing investment portfolios.
But the reality is that reform only happens when enough people demand it. So today, I'm asking for your voice: Will you add your name if you agree that members of Congress should be banned from trading individual stocks while in office? [https://go.marieforcongress.com/a/ban-stock-trading]

Washington works best when the people have confidence that their representatives are acting in the public interest.

| | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _

And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

For decades, Oregon has led the nation in making voting more accessible.
We've pioneered vote-by-mail. We created Automatic Voter Registration. We've shown that making it easier to vote strengthens our democracy.
But there's still more work to do.
Right now, Oregon's Voters' Rights Act provides important protections against vote dilution in school board elections and special districts
That's a good start. But it shouldn't be the finish line.
As Donald Trump and reckless Republicans wage a war on our voting rights in Washington, I believe that every Oregon voter deserves the same protections — whether they're voting for a school board member, a city councilor, a county commissioner, or any other elected office.
That's why it's time to expand the Oregon Voters' Rights Act so its protections apply statewide, to every candidate, every voter, and every campaign. If you agree that every Oregon voter deserves equal protection under the law, add your name today. >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/bcf7Ra7JfEKkSrH5ZGgwxw2]

Our democracy works best when every community has a fair opportunity to elect representatives of their choice.
We've spent years building one of the strongest election systems in America. Expanding voting rights is the next step in that work.
And in the face of the Supreme Court’s relentless attacks on the national Voting Rights Act — and Donald Trump’s commitment to suppressing your right to vote — this fight has never mattered more.
That’s why I’m asking you to take a stand today. If enough of us speak up together, we can build the momentum to strengthen Oregon's democracy for generations to come. Will you sign your name? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/bcf7Ra7JfEKkSrH5ZGgwxw2]

clean_body: ? [?] ? [?] For decades, Oregon has led the nation in making voting more accessible. We've pioneered vote-by-mail. We created Automatic Voter Registration. We've shown that making it easier to vote strengthens our democracy. But there's still more work to do. Right now, Oregon's Voters' Rights Act provides important protections against vote dilution in school board elections and special districts That's a good start. But it shouldn't be the finish line. As Donald Trump and reckless Republicans wage a war on our voting rights in Washington, I believe that every Oregon voter deserves the same protections — whether they're voting for a school board member, a city councilor, a county commissioner, or any other elected office. That's why it's time to expand the Oregon Voters' Rights Act so its protections apply statewide, to every candidate, every voter, and every campaign. If you agree that every Oregon voter deserves equal protection under the law, add your name today. >> [] ADD YOUR NAME [] Our democracy works best when every community has a fair opportunity to elect representatives of their choice. We've spent years building one of the strongest election systems in America. Expanding voting rights is the next step in that work. And in the face of the Supreme Court’s relentless attacks on the national Voting Rights Act — and Donald Trump’s commitment to suppressing your right to vote — this fight has never mattered more. That’s why I’m asking you to take a stand today. If enough of us speak up together, we can build the momentum to strengthen Oregon's democracy for generations to come. Will you sign your name? | | | Dear Peter,
---
Whether you're seeing the redwoods for the first time or the thousandth, they tend to have the same effect: At some point, you look up and whisper to yourself, _wow._ That sense of awe is at the heart of ABC News' _Wonders of America_ , which marks America's 250th anniversary with a tour of seven of the country's greatest natural treasures. Redwoods share the list with icons like the Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, and Hawaii's volcanoes, underscoring their place among America's most extraordinary landscapes.
---
---
In the show, journalist David Muir follows Save the Redwoods League restoration expert Ben Blom, scientists, foresters, and Tribal leaders into the field to discover what makes redwoods unlike anything else on Earth. Inspired by _Wonders of America_ , we created our own list of seven reasons coast redwoods deserve their place among America's natural wonders. **[Read the story](https://click.everyaction.com/k/135040804/632907110/1272208862?utm_campaign=storysend&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-news-all&sourceid=1170582&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEzYjk0M2RiLTg2N2MtZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=f6fJnT6XTjcO23CvHVMc45FvfAWhjLXx3TOkboPqHNw=&emci=3a959106-037b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=13b943db-867c-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1504551)** , watch the feature, and discover how these trees drink fog, support entire ecosystems high above the forest floor, and grow tall enough to make "wow" a full-body experience.

Friend, The Trump administration unleashed a new attack on transgender people, undocumented immigrants, people who need abortions, and organizations that advance gender and racial equity — including those addressing Black maternal health. His Office of Management and Budget issued a new proposed rule to block federal funding for groups, hospitals, universities, homeless shelters, Tribal programs, and other institutions that provide life-saving services for these communities. It would force these entities receiving federal grants to discriminate against and stop serving trans people, undocumented immigrants, and any marginalized group targeted by this administration’s racist and bigoted ideology. They’d also need to erase public references to trans people’s existence. This is outrageous! We must protect our marginalized neighbors from this latest attack. Trump has sometimes backpedaled after public backlash, and we’ve got a few more days before the public comment period for this rule ends on Monday, July 13. **[Please sign to submit an official public comment opposing this attack on our undocumented and transgender neighbors.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3870I8FIxNwa3la6PaSv4UGJegVi4CHcGKOLiTtE9hylrXxsXBCYDTJ0XaZ-3gQlMn5i2ZeCl12MCcLD765eYNk-O4Hm_7ibYqg1j51tMQUh_75nWT087Io_USVak3feYtzzLlu56lLQCvA54fINHTJEE7RLamETaFs_p2AlO6EQITxNc1aObGQiespr_NHu_5NkIS8utzGb-R5T5Q2uhbxQTD2x90k9gXBplKBjLBbYUwHqjGoiDXqr7D7vRS2VF5QDdN9I_ASGfHAEfz3EcMqN1ThgQrfXzw3rCvBxx11pUv9oL_CC_kTCFCEvMGRC8OjiXbicsmVkAn7jSd_KOKpPSKOU8i6-q899uArsU-3B1im3AoYqLv_jeoH26Jm_t5YEy19E_PIH7ohZI7K6Hi2/4s7/BtkF8R7rSMyEul-owAkPiw/h1/h001.-mi5Z6BYYv7yTaRcPUMWtfmiL2NluJmPeYyvySVKyt4)** | [SUBMIT COMMENT BEFORE JULY 13 DEADLINE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3870I8FIxNwa3la6PaSv4UGJegVi4CHcGKOLiTtE9hylrXxsXBCYDTJ0XaZ-3gQlMn5i2ZeCl12MCcLD765eYNk-O4Hm_7ibYqg1j51tMQUh_75nWT087Io_USVak3feYtzzLlu56lLQCvA54fINHTJEE7RLamETaFs_p2AlO6EQITxNc1aObGQiespr_NHu_63ybQ_rruM9bt6qijxrTWpBtXbZPsXROb1XXeCog3sZswdk6JJBXEAys-pF3mL_KQ5KovqASN-4p2vcMf1_D9znwftRH_9xnPeaQmJuB67PBqy_zoayeDW1CUkdRopXgCpb2sx1eX3fP35QufhHSZKWr4uc_lVtcPeh4LF1pBm6ltjQoNjk2cqlTQeFAmAGFs-7YiB2YUw5eRmvGup2JzK/4s7/BtkF8R7rSMyEul-owAkPiw/h2/h001.PxnQXEXYUSsEd8ETwQWBARcYqhjr2Ts1nNNrln9PF-0)

Unless we stop it, this proposed rule will overhaul our government’s grant-making process, where nonpartisan experts currently make funding decisions.
It requires a “pre-issuance review” by a political appointee, which will insert right-wing partisanship _and also_ create huge delays in sending out congressionally approved federal funds.
It would enable presidential administrations to punish grant recipients for noncompliance, even letting the administration revoke and take back funding that’s already been allocated.
Set to be finalized this fall, this rule also creates a lot of confusion and hurdles for groups involved in voter registration — which could impact this November’s mid-term elections.

I will always stand with trans people, immigrants, and other marginalized communities.
I’ve introduced and co-sponsored legislation to combat discrimination against LGBTQI+ people, affirm trans people’s rights, and expand access to life-saving gender-affirming healthcare.
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3870I8FIxNwa3la6PaSv4UGJegVi4CHcGKOLiTtE9hylrXxsXBCYDTJ0XaZ-3gQlMn5i2ZeCl12MCcLD765eYNk-O4Hm_7ibYqg1j51tMQUh_75nWT087Io_USVak3feYtzzLlu56lLQCvA54fINHTJEE7RLamETaFs_p2AlO6EQITxNc1aObGQiespr_NHu_6mUwEdA85V_92XyBOuV_0RmdDwWgZsZaJOh9DifAwAqo8cbiSrD_2yqohIRVwKxwr8MoLUebXFPqib9D8G4rcxr5NceojA8CAuSIGWnC11Nza9oXNeLsEl9igjAqPHUI2GJxrawoKNR9vsAweaYant1IXzoyTNr4mtt3sIKdc8LGHwRRGLJqO5WT7mjKMgjEgXnyTnOWNNAAG1tq_-NvNW/4s7/BtkF8R7rSMyEul-owAkPiw/h5/h001.oNb0gYZRF6pbndhW60Y8U5HVBur7hNhnZKxY3HMfJhE)
As a former immigration lawyer and a child of immigrants, I’ll never stop fighting for immigrants’ rights and pushing to abolish ICE.
And I’ll keep fighting for Black maternal health and reproductive justice, including through the Mamas’ Caucus that I founded in Congress to center and advocate for mothers of color.
Together, we’ll not only take on the Trump administration’s abuses but also look beyond him — and fight for our fundamental rights and the society we all deserve.
I’m honored to be alongside you in this work for justice and dignity for all.
In solidarity,
Rashida

Trump has sometimes backpedaled after public backlash, and we’ve got a few more days before the public comment period for this rule ends on Monday, July 13. | Unless we stop it, this proposed rule will overhaul our government’s grant-making process, where nonpartisan experts currently make funding decisions. It requires a “pre-issuance review” by a political appointee, which will insert right-wing partisanship and also create huge delays in sending out congressionally approved federal funds. It would enable presidential administrations to punish grant recipients for noncompliance, even letting the administration revoke and take back funding that’s already been allocated. Set to be finalized this fall, this rule also creates a lot of confusion and hurdles for groups involved in voter registration — which could impact this November’s mid-term elections. I will always stand with trans people, immigrants, and other marginalized communities. I’ve introduced and co-sponsored legislation to combat discrimination against LGBTQI+ people, affirm trans people’s rights, and expand access to life-saving gender-affirming healthcare. As a former immigration lawyer and a child of immigrants, I’ll never stop fighting for immigrants’ rights and pushing to abolish ICE. And I’ll keep fighting for Black maternal health and reproductive justice, including through the Mamas’ Caucus that I founded in Congress to center and advocate for mothers of color. Together, we’ll not only take on the Trump administration’s abuses but also look beyond him — and fight for our fundamental rights and the society we all deserve. I’m honored to be alongside you in this work for justice and dignity for all. subject: We need to increase voter participation nationwide

body:
We refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. That means refocusing our anger and our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .
Massive voter participation is more crucial now than ever. RUSH $30 or more today and help us register a tidal wave of new voters nationwide >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=071026_2&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Supreme Court ruled in favor of voter suppression and against underrepresented communities in Louisiana v. Callais , folks.
This is a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve . If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote .
How? Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, chip in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=071026_2&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=071026_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=071026_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=071026_2&amount=50]

Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and move forward to a better future.
Our voter registration work -- at just about $3 per new voter -- is more necessary now than ever. Can you pitch in with $30 and give us the resources we need to register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=071026_2&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=071026_2&amount=20]

I'm requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master's from Harvard, a Master's Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. My request of you will end in one of two ways: 1. . 2. You might have read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I'm not a career politician. I'm a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation's call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn't the Minnesota I grew up in - or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don't live in Minnesota, then I'm sure you'll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today - individuals of integrity. subject: We’re about fed up here

body:
It is long past time for Congress to do their job and pass a war powers resolution that prevents Trump from dragging this war on for as long as he wants.
#
Ladies and Gentlemen, this is Paul Eaton, Major General, U.S. Army, Retired.
The President of the United States has made it very clear to every American that he is taking us to Forever War 3.0.
Republican politicians and pundits heaped praise on this man when he signed a “Memorandum of Understanding” with Iran. They called him the Peace President, claimed he had rewritten thousands of years of history, and demanded the Nobel Peace Prize.
Turns out that MOU was more of an IOU, because there was no plan. There is no peace with this unfortunate man, and there never was. And as if that wasn’t bad enough, he told our own allies that he is coming for Greenland. To their faces, at a NATO summit.
Folks, I grew up going to school with the children of fighter pilots from Denmark. They are our allies, and they’re good people. We’ve got to stop this.
We need to get this entire thing shut down. Republicans in Congress, this is not a can you can kick down the road. You have got to do your job, because the American people, Veterans, Military Families — we’re done. We’re done with this.
It is long past time for Congress to do its job and pass a war powers resolution that prevents Trump from dragging this war on for as long as he wants. Not a symbolic measure, not something without any teeth — a binding resolution that reclaims Congress’ constitutional power to declare war.
[**I’m asking you to join VoteVets and demand that Republicans get off their keesters, do their jobs, and stop this Iran War before it gets any more American warriors killed. Demand a binding war powers resolution.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260710_VV_war_powers_em/?source=em260710-1-120&refcode2=35326.3013755.dgqNcQ&akid=35326%2E3013755%2EdgqNcQ)

Very respectfully,
Paul Eaton

Peter,

$103 million

That's how much George Soros and his son Alex have already poured into this midterm cycle — and they're not done. Soros previously set the record for midterm spending at $128 million, and by all accounts, he's on track to blow past it.

This isn't some grassroots movement. It's one family with a fortune trying to buy the United States Senate for the Democrats.

Holding President Trump’s Senate majority comes down to a small handful of races — and three of the most important are happening right now in **Ohio, Alaska, and Montana.**

Lose any of them, and Chuck Schumer takes the gavel.

And make no mistake about what that means. Schumer will go after election integrity laws, pack the Supreme Court with liberal judges, make DC a state to expand his power, and ram through every radical priority the left has been dreaming about for years — all bankrolled by Soros' money.

Hi Peter,
I'm excited to share some big news: Our Revolution [https://ourrevolution.com/] , the national grassroots organization founded by Senator Bernie Sanders, has endorsed my campaign for Lieutenant Governor.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mrg2026-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mrg2026-em]
This endorsement is deeply meaningful because it comes from a movement of more than 4 million members nationwide, including over 107,000 Vermonters. These members believe our elected leaders should work for working people, not powerful corporations.
Our Revolution is committed to electing leaders who will stand up to Donald Trump, get corporate money out of politics, and fight for working families. I'm honored to have their support.
I've spent my career standing up for people who need someone in their corner—from fighting for human rights as an advocate and attorney, to helping resettle Afghan allies through the Vermont Afghan Alliance, to serving as Lieutenant Governor, and in my own life as a mom and caregiver to my mom.
Vermonters deserve a Lt. Governor with the experience, skills, courage and urgency to fight back against unlawful federal actions and to deliver every single day for working families across Vermont. I’m committed to doing just that.
With just 32 days until the August 11th Primary , our campaign is building real momentum.
But momentum alone won’t win this election. It will take all of us , keeping our head down, working hard, organizing, and getting every eligible Vermonter out to vote in this Primary.

Thirty-five generations ago, my ancestors built lives in the high desert of New Mexico. Growing up fishing with my dad and running through the desert with my cousins, I fell in love with New Mexico’s natural wonders and learned that we all have a responsibility to care for our planet.
_Since my childhood, I have seen the impacts of climate change on New Mexico._
That’s why, when I was elected to Congress, I fought to protect sacred lands. As Secretary of the Interior, I helped protect more land and water than any administration in U.S. history while also creating good jobs in clean energy, conservation, and cleaning up legacy pollution.
**But now all of that progress is at risk.**
Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have worked to gut environmental protections and sell off public lands — all while New Mexico stands on the front lines of the devastating impacts of climate change.
Governors are the first line of defense against the Trump agenda, especially when it comes to standing up against the brazen attacks on our environment. **And as Governor, I will be a fierce defender of our home, but I can’t win this race on my own.**
Republicans have already spent big to stop us because they care more about money than about protecting New Mexico’s families and the beautiful public lands we call home. **[So if you’re with me, friend, I’m personally asking: Will you please chip in $5 today to help power my victory in November so I can protect New Mexico’s land, water, and future?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/13377?refcode=jtk991-fr-nd&t=8&akid=10958%2E400544%2EK8XY2t)**
Thank you for doing your part to protect New Mexico for future generations.

Be Fierce,

— Deb

name: Courier Newsroom
subject: How school vouchers are draining rural Wisconsin
body:
[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1005&refcode=202607010_Vouchers&akid=137%2E344797%2Ebjdo6q ]COURIER Newsroom

Peter,

Earlier this year, COURIER expanded our local newsrooms to 20. More
reporters, in more communities, covering the stories that national outlets
never touch and local papers no longer exist to tell.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1007&refcode=202607010_Vouchers&akid=137%2E344797%2Ebjdo6q ]We want to show you what that looks like in practice. If
you're ready to fund this kind of local accountability reporting, you can
chip in any amount right here:

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1008&refcode=202607010_Vouchers&akid=137%2E344797%2Ebjdo6q ]Donate

Here's a story from UpNorthNews, our Wisconsin newsroom. It's the kind of
reporting that only happens when journalists are rooted in the communities
they cover.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/500?t=1003&refcode=202607010_Vouchers&akid=137%2E344797%2Ebjdo6q ][IMG]
Our reporter Salina Heller dug into how Wisconsin's private school voucher
program is hitting rural communities especially hard. When students leave
for private schools, their funding follows them out the door. But the
buses still run, the buildings still need heat, and the teachers still
show up for the kids who remain. Rural districts can't just cut costs to
absorb the loss.

John Gaier knows a thing or two about Wisconsin’s school districts,
especially rural ones. He’s been a teacher and an administrator in rural
western Wisconsin districts for more than 40 years.

And here's the part that stings: in many rural communities, there's no
private school nearby for most families to use anyway. So local property
taxes subsidize a program many residents can't even access.

This is the kind of accountability reporting that gets lost when local
newsrooms disappear. No dramatic hearing, no viral moment. Just a policy
quietly reshaping Wisconsin communities while most people have no idea
it's happening.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1009&refcode=202607010_Vouchers&akid=137%2E344797%2Ebjdo6q ]It's also exactly why we expanded this year. But
growing to 20 states only works if readers fund the reporting. If our
journalism has helped you better understand what's happening in Wisconsin,
please consider chipping in today.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1010&refcode=202607010_Vouchers&akid=137%2E344797%2Ebjdo6q ]Donate

Thank you for supporting local journalism,
The COURIER Team

Team, **A new poll has us within six points of Senator Markey.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135046620/632920275/2090747700?refcode=260710_sm_mm1_img1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNjY0OGMwMC05MDdjLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IOHW73ol9UDT8eCNgUm60wHE7I9nDU-4iIV04kxyZ5I=) I’m glad people are noticing. But close is not enough. I’ve beaten a longtime incumbent before. I know what it takes: you show up everywhere, talk to voters directly, and work like every vote has to be earned. Because it does. That is what I’m doing now. Peter, Something is wrong when a member of Congress treats his office like a trading desk instead of a place to represent families. Let’s go through the facts: On May 15, 2025, Congressman Rob Bresnahan sold up to $130,000 in stocks tied to health insurers like Centene, Elevance Health, UnitedHealth and CVS Health. One week later, on May 22, he was the deciding vote for a Republican mega bill that slashed Medicaid funding by nearly $1 trillion. **Centene’s stock plunged 40% after the bill was signed into law.** That same month, on May 15, Congressman Bresnahan bought Lockheed Martin stock. On June 13, 2025, war with Iran escalated and the U.S. launched strikes on Iran. **Those market moves lined up with votes and developments that raise real questions about whose interests he is serving.** In January 2026, a report named 10 rural Pennsylvania hospitals at immediate risk of closure, in part because of the Medicaid cuts he supported. **On March 27, Bresnahan dumped up to $250,000 of Pennsylvania hospital bonds just one month after voting for the budget resolution that paved the way for those cuts.** In May 2025 he made 81 trades selling clean energy holdings and buying fossil fuel stocks in moves worth at least $200,000 and as much as $1.45 million. **Just ten days later he voted for a bill that helps big oil and hurts clean energy and working families facing higher energy bills.** This is not a one-off pattern. Bresnahan ranks as the second-most active trader this Congress. He has made over 652 trades totaling $8.48 million in volume. **The numbers speak for themselves: Bresnahan isn’t in Congress to serve us, he’s serving himself while profiting off of people’s pain.** **I ran for public office to clean up a culture of corruption and make government work for real people. Now, I’m running for Congress to bring that same fight to Washington. I support banning Congressional stock trading, I won’t take corporate PAC money, and I will demand accountability and transparency in government.** **[We need to expose these conflicts and build the resources to win this seat. [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Colorado election officials told a federal court they began evaluating changes to the state’s election systems almost immediately after President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing federal agencies to overhaul parts of federal election administration.
In sworn filings, they said the order required them to divert staff time to analyze how new federal citizenship verification and ballot-mail procedures would interact with the state’s systems while preparations for the 2026 election were already underway.
Colorado runs a near all-mail system, and 92.2 percent of ballots cast in the 2024 general election were mail ballots.

**[Victor Marx Wins GOP Nomination Setting Up Colorado Governor Showdown](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_More than a week after a nail-biter primary, the AP has called the race for Victor Marx, who outspent his opponents by more than double and is now positioned to take on a state Democrats have dominated for over two decades._
* The Associated Press projected Marine Corps veteran Victor Marx as the winner of Colorado's Republican gubernatorial primary, defeating State Sen. Barbara Kirkmeyer by at least 2,142 votes out of more than 500,000 cast — a race so tight it wasn't called until more than a week after Election Day.
* Marx led the GOP field in fundraising with approximately $2.8 million in contributions, more than doubling the combined totals of both opponents, and his victory sets up a November general election against Democrat Phil Weiser, the current state attorney general.
* Colorado hasn't elected a Republican governor in more than two decades, and the state backed Democrat Kamala Harris over Donald Trump by more than 10 points in 2024 — but with incumbent Democrat Jared Polis term-limited, Marx sees an opening, telling supporters "Colorado has changed, and not for the better" and calling for a unified state focused on affordability, housing, and public safety.

name: Chaz Molder
subject: This is where I'm supposed to be.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Molder for Congress
body:
The more I have traveled through this new district, the more I believe it.

| | | | |
---
Friend,
When I first heard about the redistricting, I was angry. I am not going to pretend otherwise.
But something has shifted over the last few weeks. The more I have traveled the communities in this new TN-5, the more I have come to believe that this is exactly where I am supposed to be.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/zDrl7QZqMSg1eB6h8BkF6g~~/AAUS1hA~/tiRdNb0CVMeIW0pr_vzP0JSQo0WN1dRmf92wZwkMmA41BOKk4_w78trSnD4kNR8odAOn0FEV8g2wjmr2Yu4pwXsI9X8ayTsOW24Mhm1WsIeyGqKt_hDMiHbwEMZ4uyi7eIHe-etbAk2yaQbSiUsARD9Vv1CrU1bEnJHhdIvJyzYmR5UBWUWZsAUGebt8J-wbpn60udQ4zlHA2OFabBrEYxfrwqdhXRVw9kFr93lzTmO8QIicqUe8HvcX3lbyjIxb14B6QVw1CHW46_U32Hdn9Q~~)
Memphis, where Liz and I lived for three years and where I went to law school. Ripley, where we got married and where her dad has served this community for decades. Hickman County, where I have a family farm and spend time on the Duck River. And, of course, my hometown, where I’ve been Mayor for two terms, focused on issues that matter.
These are not just places on a map. They are places that shaped me. My values, my sense of community, my belief that neighbors should look out for each other.
Running here in the new TN-5 is not a consolation prize. It is an honor. And I believe with everything I have that we are building a coalition of voters across all 17 counties who are going to have the final say in November.

This is a true swing district. NJ-09 is one of the most competitive districts in the country. Donald Trump narrowly carried it in 2024. Then, Mikie Sherrill won here in 2025. This race is on the map as one of the few seats that could decide control of the House.

name: The Maine Democrats
subject: Susan Collins is fundraising today. We don't have a nominee yet.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend,

This week, we called on our own nominee for the U.S. Senate to withdraw. We hold every candidate who seeks to carry our banner to the highest standard, and we stand with women and survivors. That principle does not bend based on party affiliation.

He has now withdrawn.

The hard decision in this story was not ours. It belonged to the women who came forward, because speaking up is often costly, and we respect them for it.

Our responsibility required judgment and a willingness to act when circumstances demanded it. Circumstances demanded it. We acted.

Now we want to talk to you about what happens next, because it matters enormously.

**There is no Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Maine.**

Our party will come together, as our rules provide, to choose the Democrat who will carry our banner against Susan Collins. We will do it carefully and we will do it right. Mainers deserve nothing less.

But here is the hard truth about that gap:

Susan Collins does not pause while we confer. She has been raising money for this race for six years. Her campaign is raising more today, and it will raise more tomorrow. The corporate PACs and wealthy interests her votes protect are not waiting to see who our nominee is. They are adding to a war chest six years in the making, while our side has no candidate, no campaign, and no one answering. Whoever we choose will start this race six years behind.

Every day of this holding period is a day she banks money unanswered.

We refuse to let our next nominee start from zero.

So the Maine Democratic Party is opening the **Day One Fund** : money raised now, held ready, so that the moment our new nominee is chosen, they inherit a running start instead of an empty account.

Day one, they will need a statewide organizing operation already paid for.
Day one, they will need voter contact already underway in all 16 counties.
Day one, they will need to answer Collins on the air, not spend a month catching up.

[That is what this fund does. Not a bailout, not a rainy-day account. A running start, waiting for whoever earns the nomination. clean_body: It's been over a year since President Trump pardoned us J6 prisoners. Patriot, It's been over a year since President Trump pardoned us J6 prisoners. But even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers... Some are homeless to this day. Some can 't get a job because of the time they've spent in jail. Many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life. They have been separated from their families for years. They have had their rights stripped from them. They can't vote. They can't own a firearm. Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life -- law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions. And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights. So what comes next for J6ers? There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That's exactly what Stand in the Gap Foundation is helping them do. Stand in the Gap Foundation originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is on helping those J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated. We are committed to providing comprehensive, practical support to ensure that each individual can rebuild their life with dignity, hope, and purpose. Our mission is deeply rooted in the conviction that legal forgiveness is only the beginning. We want to give J6ers the support to fully reintegrate into their communities with the strength to start anew. Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not. We were founded to "stand in the gap" for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. We want them to know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing housing and vehicles, counseling, and confidential peer support; the tools needed for healing and reintegration. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

“We deserve better.”

That’s the message at the heart of Donavan McKinney’s very first TV ad,
and it’s exactly why Justice Democrats is proud to stand with him in the
Democratic primary for Michigan’s 13th district.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260710-1-dm.qSRgp_&refcode=em20260710-38009&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38009%2E1203867%2E4hX7m9 ]Tweet from @DonavanMI13: "Happy Tuesday, everyone! Our new TV ad, "We
Deserve Better," is officially out — and it's a reminder of exactly what
this campaign is all about. Watch it 👇🏾"; attached is a still from the ad,
with Donavan looking towards the camera and the words "Donavan McKinney:
We Deserve Better" overlayed in yellow font

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260710-1-dm.qSRgp_&refcode=em20260710-38009&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38009%2E1203867%2E4hX7m9 ]If you’re ready to replace Do-Nothing Democrat Shri Thanedar with a
real fighter for Detroit on August 4th, split a donation to Donavan’s
campaign and JD now →

Donavan is a state representative, union organizer, husband, and father
who’s spent his career fighting for his community. He was born next to
smokestacks, moved thirteen times as a kid, and spent the rest of his life
working to give back to the place and people he loves.

While his incumbent opponent spent millions of dollars to buy his seat in
Congress, voted to thank ICE, and lied to voters about taking corporate
PAC checks, Donavan has been delivering for Michiganders. From securing
$600 million to replace lead pipes to millions more for public schools,
Donavan has always put the people first.

Now, he’s ready to bring that same fight to Congress.

Unlike Shri, Donavan will be a true champion for Medicare for All, a Green
New Deal, abolishing ICE, ending taxpayer-funded forever wars and
genocide, and making billionaires finally pay their fair share.

And he’ll do it all without taking a cent from corporate PACS or AIPAC —
because he’s accountable to the people he serves, not the wealthiest
donors.

The contrast couldn’t be clearer: Donavan has always fought for the
people. Shri Thanedar has always fought for himself.

With this primary less than a month away, we need your urgent help to keep
Donavan’s new ad on the air, reach as many voters as possible, and fight
back against Thanedar’s fortune and the corporate cash flooding this race
to save his seat.

Our movement has the momentum to take home the win in the Mighty 13th —
but only if we have the resources to meet the moment.

This is important, especially today. Please give me a chance to explain. We’ve found out that Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth's Department of War are investigating me over my support for Ukraine after the Russian invasion. Here's the truth: Donald Trump tried to get revenge on me and my brother after we reported the phone call that led to his first impeachment. Then I demanded he release the transcript of the shocking call he had with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. The very next day this "investigation" was referred to the House Ethics Committee. body:
This isn't a minor policy debate.

| [](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
I want your opinion, Peter. Should cities be allowed to ignore federal immigration law and
declare themselves sanctuary cities? | [ Yes ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
[ No ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._webje8y-u8FRIMTCEQ)
This is personal for me. I grew up in Cincinnati. It’s my hometown – the place that shaped everything I believe about America. My parents immigrated here with almost nothing, but they built a life because America was a nation of laws. A place where hard work was rewarded and the rules applied to everyone equally.
So it cut deep when Cincinnati declared itself a sanctuary city.
Think about the dangerous precedent that it sets. A local government openly standing up and saying: We will choose which federal laws we want to obey. If the government itself refuses to respect the law, why should anyone else?
[This isn't a minor policy debate. This is the very fabric of our republic unraveling. An open border is not a border. A sanctuary city is actively rejecting the nation it sits in.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._ArBvs_2Il-XA)
When you pick and choose which laws matter, you don’t get a more compassionate society. You get crime. You get chaos. You get a total collapse of public trust. We watched this disaster play out in real-time across America under the Biden administration because the rule of law was abandoned from the top down.
[](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)[We cannot allow this lawlessness to become the permanent norm. We have to draw a line in the sand, right here and right now.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._0Zn9Yg9NHA)
Peter, if you believe that a country without borders and without laws is no country at all, I need you to do two things immediately:
[1\. ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._UFP4r8s6_AZ_AXErJHw)[Cast your official vote in our poll right now.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._XN1MEfR0Brznu3k4-VTg)

2\. [Chip in $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can afford immediately to help us save Ohio, and save America, this November.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
The Left is pouring millions of dollars into Ohio to promote their open-border agenda and drown out our message. We are the only thing standing in their way, but I can't fight this battle alone.
Don't let them turn our home into a sanctuary for lawlessness.
Thank you,Vivek

name: Quinton Grounds
subject: Hope to See You There! Upcoming Events w/ Marni
body:
Hi all!

It's been a busy July already and we have some several upcoming events that we'd love to invite you out to!

Next **Saturday, July 18th** is the biggest party in San Diego County - SD Pride! And we'd love to have YOU there with us as we celebrate our incredible community and enjoy the summer weather! Bring your friends! The Parade starts at **10 AM in Hillcrest** and we'll follow up with you with more details on meeting location and parking when you **sign up on our form here:** [**https://forms.gle/hh7ceKSkPQnZowcM6**](https://forms.gle/hh7ceKSkPQnZowcM6)

This **Sunday, July 12th from 12-3 PM** we are giving a huge thank you to the volunteers that made the Primary possible with our **Volunteer Appreciation Lunch**! Come out for some delicious BBQ and great vibes - we wouldn't be here without you! **RSVP here:[ https://forms.gle/ZdBVcudJforaZQjKA](https://forms.gle/ZdBVcudJforaZQjKA)**

Want to join us for a Phonebank or Weekend Canvass? Check out the Coordinated Campaign's upcoming Mobilize Events here!

**Saturday, July 11 -[Canvass in Winchester](https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/966122/?referring_vol=12891370&rname=Quinton&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link)**
**Sunday, July 12 -[Canvass in Vista](https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/965832/?referring_vol=12891370&rname=Quinton&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link) **
**Tuesday, July 14 -[Virtual Phonebank](https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/887949/?referring_vol=12891370&rname=Quinton&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link)**

Thank you for all of your support and can't wait to see you all soon!

Best Regards,
Quinton with Team Marni

body:
| | | Hi Peter, **Yesterday, Donald Trump fired the remaining members of the bipartisan Election Assistance Commission.** Most people have never heard of the EAC—and that's because it's supposed to be an independent, behind-the-scenes agency that helps states administer secure elections, certifies voting systems, and supports election officials across the country. It was created after the 2000 election to help states administer elections, certify voting systems, distribute federal election funding, and share best practices with local election officials. States like Colorado actually run elections. But election administration works because professionals share information, test equipment, coordinate on security, and solve problems together. The EAC has been central to that work for over two decades. **So why is Trump gutting it? Because his goal isn't to make elections work better. It's to make independent institutions answer to one person instead of the public.** That's exactly why this race matters. As Colorado's next Secretary of State, I'll be on the front lines defending our elections from political interference. I've spent my career writing voting rights laws, administering elections, and standing up to anyone who tries to undermine the freedom to vote. I know what's at stake, and I know how to fight back. But we can't do it alone. We're up against a far-right Republican opponent who opposes mail ballots, and national attention on this race will only continue to grow. Every conversation we have with voters, every organizer we put in the field, and every ad we run depends on grassroots supporters like you. **If you're able, will you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us protect Colorado's elections and build a democracy that's stronger than the attacks against it?[Donate here to help take our democracy back](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsMG_9gwoTVGQS_43JiLOWhwG3-7h8gYnzjzDMgmCjBZi5aJjNmqzNXg_bByjHEoJW0g6Q6GSHVYHaXo_YIJFc_LWdUwX-reCvj2mrf_FmNidI7FLiUrfPK-w9E4OXJUEvYhRUrE6usJgFhAOQB_uAIN-ql29Z9qaDf8QXGLY2SDMIGNdFodijv5vZXv0kmaFPoJcobZ_02ss0qtqMScyRkeuZRb9pIeioGIqAK4kid5LbDzZ76pWFb8JyuCJxvPyUxaMsJhY8VKMTt7xJS5oJtFaMHOXIxd5LFC73XS18YDlSfNs-51GyvuwAGKCjUuZk/4s7/OBmJAir0SLmKmCdy2tUpbg/h0/h001.NJ1Z-UmjDH5TfsRokjASs7n9dwd6m0dEOIbUlRLGiAI).** Democracy isn't self-executing. name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.
**[I’m asking you to split a donation between Chris Pappas and me. We’re going to do everything we can to take back Congress this November, and Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be asking if this wasn’t important.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260710_2.7acJMn&refcode=em20260710-2&t=1&akid=7659%2E582294%2Eiz9-Xf)**

Thank you.

## One Donor Plea Inspired 8,000
Warren Shen, a 29-year-old software engineer, was diagnosed with high-risk acute myeloid leukemia in March after routine blood work revealed the aggressive cancer. When he learned he would likely need a stem cell transplant, he also learned how difficult it can be for [Asian American patients to find a match](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OozAURJ8GOiP_CYfCxTbpsu2W1g2-hrtrbGQ7oOTpV-QVvvZoNDM6fx7uARQpLb9hQxuW4FrILuFZI7aGxfmccvGFDqRUdypYT2jzuoGTXI6MGya480Dx7XTvbUCUqHq0wtyUEeomRb9afKrJPG8XAe1HD2oUQRnNUXANYu7JXm3cCC45V2oaAofJCKFHDXxSE3Sao6eWy_A3U2orhvjOB5Zhzlsf7draXjv1q5P3Tt7P8xyer88nIPor0Ml7vA4uJddKacFyEXz9w42A7dAIU6vsoAKR7RGBhVxYbbixGWNkXwd9sX4_KUaqo-k0Xzag-J1vP_Z2WPk_AAD__1hLhhY), since minority communities remain significantly underrepresented in donor registries. Warren started posting about his diagnosis on TikTok, hoping to get a few more people to register. The response was staggering. According to the National Marrow Donor Program, more than [8,000 people signed up](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb_G3l70AMeYgaFLtnTtaBHzsF-DjQXUaf6-Sn6h85Wuzjlf1_HqOPI2f7qVbJjDWEMaN3qUSLVSHn3aUvaZD-Kt7JypPFydltWNEmUPqEHg6B3H59i13gYiSaolK_SgtFCDFO1izzoEL7vprHQww6T92Qy33gvjbkZNGFq2rzfUAiWiUuYU0BktRNd3Do0yrumQPNeUT9-Jt7pQiM90UD5NaW2jXWrdS6M-Gnlp5GWntEd6TY28rG4rUPle0x0O9pQKLBR3cN7DAIgIpdIKE8UIb9kCNUGmmUvNT6DfKf4UPgiEROwG1G22fn9wjFx63XQ4r47jm6P-O-Bh5V8AAAD__04khy0) to join the donor registry after seeing his videos, with more than 5,000 from Asian American backgrounds. "_To hear from NMDP that it went into the thousands was like, wow_ ," Warren said. "_This has allowed us to spread the message to so many more people than we ever could have in person_." Doctors are still evaluating potential matches. In the meantime, Warren is focused on treatment and [encouraging others](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFurDAQgOHTQGc0HnsxFC5eQ7evTWlNYIBJjL0y1qK9fbS5Qupf-or_4x7uJFHS9p8O9uu2hrrmkPg6I9fKJSw55bIUebKk8yGFz4vqvB8UELBX4JSGsJDEV7Dt4ldmZNOy124wTpsBdbt709th_pwdE4MFpxmR0NxmGLS-Ifat-LcGTgMCGDN2K9DotLa9JRjNSI0FXqTm0n1lSXXnNb7yk0s356ONfq_1cTbmX4NTg9N1XR3l-G4NTlSqzJHPBqeDksJR5RRfKub8LWlTObFCsM6OANDt9Yht8cvjkhjl7F1jYTtIfrG2_vnQ0-NPAAAA__8ur3o7) to consider joining the registry with a simple cheek swab. "_There is a way to legitimately save someone's life, and it's very easy to do_ ," he said.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Peter,
The FBI had battering rams and guns at the ready when they raided the offices of the progressive Ohio Organizing Collaborative.
They detained workers there for hours, subjecting them to interrogation without counsel present.
According to the group's leadership, they also questioned volunteers and even their underage children at their homes -- clear acts of intimidation to scare the organization's members from standing up to the Trump regime.
Ohio Organizing Collaborative registers voters and builds collective power to fight for criminal justice reform, racial justice and an expansion of voting rights. They focus on major cities in Ohio, areas that typically support Democrats.
It's no wonder why the FBI put on a show with their chilling raid of OCC.
But here's the twist, and a beacon of hope in the utter darkness of Trump's authoritarian regime: the leaders of OCC didn't just accept their fate and give up. Within 24 hours, they went public with what happened and created the "Hands Off Ohio" campaign to fight back, tell their story, and warn similar groups of more displays of intimidation to come.

This is America, not Russia. | | | | | == | Peter, The FBI had battering rams and guns at the ready when they raided the offices of the progressive Ohio Organizing Collaborative. They detained workers there for hours, subjecting them to interrogation without counsel present. According to the group's leadership, they also questioned volunteers and even their underage children at their homes -- clear acts of intimidation to scare the organization's members from standing up to the Trump regime. Ohio Organizing Collaborative registers voters and builds collective power to fight for criminal justice reform, racial justice and an expansion of voting rights. They focus on major cities in Ohio, areas that typically support Democrats. It's no wonder why the FBI put on a show with their chilling raid of OCC. But here's the twist, and a beacon of hope in the utter darkness of Trump's authoritarian regime: the leaders of OCC didn't just accept their fate and give up. Within 24 hours, they went public with what happened and created the "Hands Off Ohio" campaign to fight back, tell their story, and warn similar groups of more displays of intimidation to come. | == Trump is launching preemptive attacks on our freedom to vote, our First Amendment guarantee to free speech and free assembly, and the foundation of our Constitution. They know they are going to lose in November. The only way they can survive the reckoning headed their way is to cheat and suppress the opposition. Why is McConnell Ghosting America?
| | | | |
---
| | | _([Click here to go to petition](https://default.salsalabs.org/T460cde7b-1896-4140-b27c-f9d14e4c6aca/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) / Already taken this action? Forward to others! America Deserves Answers?"](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta6cb22e6-0bf7-47f9-a608-ab975c93ffd1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Senator Mitch McConnell has not been seen publicly since mid-June, [after reportedly being rushed to a hospital](https://default.salsalabs.org/T05a15f4a-dbf6-4997-9f6a-a32e3fb93fb0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9b5b24e9-7a56-472c-9e09-01bcc3fa2eb1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Look, the guy has done all kinds of awful things that have been terrible for America. But we’re not monsters, and we hope he makes a full recovery — and maybe even does something to guarantee all Americans the same kind of apparently excellent health coverage that he has. But he is still a sitting United States senator, and public office requires public accountability. **Kentuckians — and all Americans — deserve a clear update on McConnell’s health, his ability to serve, and when he expects to return to public duties.** No senator, of either party, should be allowed to disappear from public view while voters are told simply to trust that everything is fine. **[Add your name: Senator McConnell and his office should provide a clear public update about his health, capacity to serve, and expected return to public duties.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb78d9b2a-0dbe-4d51-9092-a71da54e7c98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** And remember to forward this to friends! Online actions like this are a quick and easy way to explain an issue in less than a minute, and get others on board!

body:
I need to brief you immediately

| | | | | Patriot,

I've faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington | Fellow Conservative, My name is Adam Schwarze, and I'm a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz's handpicked lieutenant governor - a politician even more radical than her boss. I'm requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master's from Harvard, a Master's Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. My request of you will end in one of two ways: 1. . 2. You might have read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I'm not a career politician. I'm a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation's call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn't the Minnesota I grew up in - or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don't live in Minnesota, then I'm sure you'll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today - individuals of integrity. That's not who my opponent is. We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven't done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. As a Republican, I know the odds are tough in a state that hasn't voted red in a presidential election since 1976. But as a former Navy SEAL, I thrive in tough fights. I've faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington. Here's what I stand for: Restoring law and order by supporting our police and cracking down on crime. Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses. Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty. Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values. Stopping the radical left's agenda that's eroding the America we love. This race won't be easy. The Democrats have deep pockets, and the radical left will stop at nothing to keep this seat. I'm running to serve you, to protect our way of life, and to ensure Minnesota remains a place where faith, family, and freedom thrive. I hope you'll invest in me right now - any amount will help. body:
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=457%2E127862%2E7w847O)
Hi, it’s Pete Buttigieg.
I want to ask you a simple question: is life more affordable than it was a year ago?
For most Americans, the answer is no.
Families are paying more for everyday goods. Small businesses are dealing with higher costs and more uncertainty. And while Americans are being asked to absorb the costs of Trump's tariffs and economic chaos, we're watching politicians in Washington focus on the wrong priorities.
It doesn't have to be this way.
The answer isn't more excuses or more chaos. It's leadership willing to stand up for consumers, hold powerful interests accountable, and focus on the issues that actually affect people's lives.
**That's why I'm supporting Aaron Ford for Governor of Nevada.**
When Donald Trump's policies threatened Nevada families and businesses, Governor Joe Lombardo's response was to minimize what people were going through, suggesting that people might just need to endure "a little pain in the short term."
Aaron Ford took a different approach.
As Attorney General, he's challenged the abuses that make life more expensive and more difficult for working families. He's taken on corporate landlords accused of manipulating rents, fought drug companies over the cost of prescription medications, and repeatedly won in court when standing up for Nevadans.
Now he's running for governor because Nevada deserves leadership focused on lowering costs, expanding opportunity, and making government work for the people it serves.
This race is expected to be one of the closest governor's races in the country. Recent polling shows Aaron has a clear path to victory over the incumbent Governor, but building a statewide campaign takes resources.
**[So if you're able, will you join me in supporting Aaron Ford with a contribution of $5 or whatever makes sense for you today?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260710_1_ak.i_2hAs&amount=5&refcode=em20260710-454&t=3&akid=457%2E127862%2E7w847O)**

Thank you,
Pete

A year ago this week, Trump and Republicans rammed through historic cuts to Medicaid and SNAP — and gutted the clean energy tax incentives that saved you money. They did it so they could pay for a tax giveaway for the wealthy. That decision is still hurting families across New Mexico. Parents are choosing between prescriptions and groceries. Rural hospitals are struggling to keep their doors open. And the clean energy programs that helped lower utility bills and create jobs were undercut, making it harder for our communities to save money and breathe cleaner air. I ran for Senate to fight for working families like yours. # George Washington Won With
Maryland's 400.

Now, let's remember them and fight for Maryland's future.
Dear ,
You've heard the story. 400 brave Maryland soldiers of the First Maryland Regiment under Major Gist heroically stood their ground at the Old Stone House in Brooklyn buying General George Washington and 9,000 Continental troops precious time to escape across the East River, thereby saving the American War for Independence in its infancy.

The Maryland 400 held the line - later earning our State the nickname by General Washington as the "Old Line State."

And I need you to be part of our ["Maryland 400" team now](https://us.list-manage.com/14BWRHSFv0D?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

I am asking you to stop what you are doing and help us hold the line once again. Democratic Socialists, whom Governor Moore has praised, are seeking to use Maryland and your tax dollars to advance their attack on our State and Nation.

The Republican Governor's Association has stepped up to endorse and help us. However, we need to raise a war chest NOW.

**We are launching the "Maryland 400" to stand once again as the Old Line State.** I am asking 400 Marylanders to join by each [donating $2500](https://us.list-manage.com/nqO7ikLB8pr?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) to help us reach our initial goal to beat Wes Moore and save Maryland.

If you cannot be part of our Maryland 400, then for our 250th anniversary of this Nation, would you chip in $250? If everyone on this e-mail list donated even just $100 we would have what we need to hold the line and win against Wes Moore and his tax and spend, high fees, high cost of living plans for you and me and our State.

This is a timely request. We only have 30 days to do this and show those that want to help us that we are ready for the fight and bringing it together. Please donate today and be part of history - remember the Maryland 400.

Thank you,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

The 15,000 member volunteer network behind Graham Platner is now using its considerable leverage to push whoever replaces him as the Democratic Senate nominee to be aligned with the same policy platform that drove the largest primary turnout in Maine state history.
Drop Site has obtained a draft letter addressed "to the Maine Democratic Party and prospective candidates" notifying them of their policy demands. Platner [formally withdrew](https://substack.com/redirect/5c9830d3-9812-4e80-bd6e-4f0dbae04350?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the Senate race on Friday.
Those policies include "healthcare as a right, housing affordability, an economy that works for regular people and not billionaires, strengthening workers and unions, end forever wars, oppose complicity in atrocities, an end to mass-deportation enforcement, energy and climate accountability, and human rights for all."
"The volunteer infrastructure that this movement built - the organizers, door-knockers, the small-dollar donors, the hosts, the people who make phone calls and staff tables between now and November - does not transfer automatically to whoever the Party selects," the letter states. "That infrastructure exists because people believe in a specific platform. It will only continue to exist and only continue to be deployed for a nominee who **publicly and explicitly adopts these core commitments** as their own." (Emphasis in the original.)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.8RlOvcn3nekvaRwjcFTJFC0t-Ss2LmHRVTe2gu89b3A?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=206499395)
While the policies are broadly agreed upon, whether the volunteers will fully withhold support from the new nominee if they do not agree is still being debated. The most hotly contested line in the draft states, "If the Party's selected nominee does not publicly adopt this platform, we want to be transparent now, before the convention, rather than silent until after it: this statewide volunteer network will not organize, fundraise, or mobilize on that candidate's behalf."
The draft makes clear "that is not a threat, but rather a statement of fact about what motivates the people who make up this movement."
Hundreds of volunteers have already signed onto the letter, with representation from every county in Maine. Several volunteers, however, still felt the language was too strong.
"I think we need to soften this somewhat," one volunteer noted in the comments. "How about, 'it will be next to impossible to motivate this statewide volunteer network." Another volunteer agreed, saying "Everyone's choice to support the Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate is their own. We can't force anyone to continue or not continue."
It has not been decided when this letter will be submitted. The State Convention to select a new candidate is expected to take place before the July 27 selection deadline.
## **The Replacement Process**
The Maine Democratic Party's 100-person state committee voted to approve a process by which 600 delegates, 500 county committee elected delegates, and the 100 state committee members themselves will select the new nominee from a slate of candidates vying to replace Platner. Troy Jackson, Shenna Bellows, Nirav Shah, Dan Kleban, Jordan Wood, and Vallie Geiger are running for the spot. All the candidates lost their respective Democratic gubernatorial and congressional primaries in June, aside from Geiger, who serves as a state representative for the Rockland area.
[Drop Site obtained private Maine Democratic Party information](https://substack.com/redirect/f84dbc4f-47af-4726-8000-3e25257d10a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) showing that the 500 delegates will be proportionally appointed based on 2024 election Democratic vote totals in their respective counties. How those 500 delegates will be elected is still under debate.
